title.zh: 卷518 列傳三百五 藩部一 科尔沁 扎赉特 杜尔伯特 郭尔罗斯 喀喇沁 土默特
title.en: Volume 518 Biographies 305: Frontier Dependencies 1: Khorchin, Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Harqin, Tumed
title.raw: 卷518 列傳三百五 藩部一 科尔沁 扎赉特 杜尔伯特 郭尔罗斯 喀喇沁 土默特

sentences.zh: 清起東夏，始定內盟。

translations.literal: The Qing arose in eastern Xia and at first established the inner leagues.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing dynasty rose in the eastern Xia region and first consolidated the Inner Mongol leagues.

sentences.zh: 康熙、乾隆兩戡准部。

translations.literal: Kangxi and Qianlong twice subdued the Dzungar department.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Kangxi and Qianlong reigns the court twice pacified the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 自松花、黑龍諸江，迤邐而西，絕大漠，亙金山，疆丁零、鮮卑之域，南盡昆侖、析支、渠搜，三危既宅，至於黑水，皆為籓部。

translations.literal: From the Sungari and Amur rivers, winding westward, crossing the great desert, spanning the Golden Mountains, bordering the lands of the Dingling and Xianbei, south to Kunlun, Qizhi, and Qusou, with Sanwei settled, as far as the Black River—all became frontier dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: From the Sungari and Amur rivers the frontier ran west in a great arc across the desert and the Altai range, through the old territories of the Dingling and Xianbei, and south to Kunlun, Qizhi, Qusou, and the settled lands of Sanwei, down to the Amur—all of it organized as Qing frontier dependencies.

sentences.zh: 撫馭賓貢，夐越漢、唐。

translations.literal: Comforting and controlling tributary guests, far surpassing Han and Tang.
translations.idiomatic: In governing and receiving tribute from its frontier subjects, the Qing far outstripped even Han and Tang.

sentences.zh: 屏翰之重，所以寵之；

translations.literal: The weight of screen-and-rampart defense was the means by which they were favored;
translations.idiomatic: They were honored as the dynasty's outer shield and inner bulwark;

sentences.zh: 甥舅之聯，所以戚之；

translations.literal: The ties of nephew and uncle-by-marriage were the means by which they were drawn near;
translations.idiomatic: marriage alliances bound them as kin;

sentences.zh: 銳劉之衛，所以懷之；

translations.literal: The guarding of elite forces was the means by which their hearts were won;
translations.idiomatic: elite military service won their loyalty;

sentences.zh: 教政之修，所以宣之。

translations.literal: The cultivation of civilizing government was the means by which it was proclaimed to them.
translations.idiomatic: and the spread of civilizing policy made the court's will known throughout the frontier.

sentences.zh: 世更十二，載越廿紀，虔奉約束，聿共盟會，奧矣昌矣。

translations.literal: Twelve generations passed and more than twenty reign-periods elapsed; they reverently observed their bonds and jointly shared league assemblies—profound and flourishing indeed.
translations.idiomatic: Through twelve reigns and more than twenty decades they reverently kept their obligations and met in league assembly together—a frontier order both deep-rooted and thriving.

sentences.zh: 若夫元之戚垣，自為風氣；

translations.literal: As for the Yuan's imperial kin-walls, each kept its own customs;
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan had its imperial kin, each with its own ways;

sentences.zh: 明之蕃衛，虛有名字，蓋未可以同年而語。

translations.literal: the Ming's frontier guards existed only as empty names—truly they cannot be spoken of in the same breath.
translations.idiomatic: while the Ming's frontier guards were little more than names on paper—hardly comparable at all.

sentences.zh: 帶礪之盛，具見世表。

translations.literal: The grandeur of girdle-and-whetstone investiture is fully set forth in the tables by reign.
translations.idiomatic: The full splendor of these investitures and frontier honors is recorded reign by reign in the chronological tables.

sentences.zh: 茲綜事實，列之為傳。

translations.literal: Here the facts are gathered together and arranged as biographies.
translations.idiomatic: Here the facts are gathered and set out in the biographies that follow.

sentences.zh: 揆文奮武，悅近來遠，疏附禦侮，可得大凡。

translations.literal: Measuring civil and martial achievement, drawing the near and welcoming the far, keeping the distant attached and repelling insult—from these the general pattern may be grasped.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and martial policy, winning those near and attracting those far, binding the distant and repelling enemies—the general pattern of Qing frontier rule emerges from these themes.

sentences.zh: 末造顛頹，乃彰畔渙。

translations.literal: In the dynasty's final decline, rebellion and disunion came plainly to light.
translations.idiomatic: Only in the dynasty's final decline did rebellion and disunion stand out plainly.

sentences.zh: 盛衰得失，斯可鑒已。

translations.literal: Rise and fall, gain and loss—here is what may serve as a mirror.
translations.idiomatic: Their rise and fall, their gains and losses—here is a lesson for posterity.

sentences.zh: 科爾沁部，在喜峰口外，至京師千二百八十里。

translations.literal: The Khorchin department lies beyond Xifeng Pass, one thousand two hundred and eighty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Khorchin league lay beyond Xifeng Pass, twelve hundred and eighty li from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 東西距八百七十里，南北距二千有百里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures eight hundred and seventy li; north to south more than two thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured eight hundred and seventy li from east to west and more than two thousand li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東紮賚特，西紮嚕特，南盛京邊牆，北黑龍江。

translations.literal: Jalaid lies to the east, Jalut to the west, the Mukden border wall to the south, and the Amur to the north.
translations.idiomatic: Jalaid lay to the east, Jalut to the west, the Mukden border wall to the south, and the Amur to the north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖削平西北諸國，建王、駙馬等世守之，為今內外扎薩克蒙古所自出。

translations.literal: The Yuan founding emperor subdued the northwestern states and established kings and imperial sons-in-law to hold them in hereditary tenure—the source of today's Inner and Outer Mongol zasak.
translations.idiomatic: Genghis Khan conquered the northwestern states and installed princes and imperial sons-in-law to hold them by hereditary tenure—the ancestors of today's Inner and Outer Mongol zasak leagues.

sentences.zh: 科爾沁始祖曰哈布圖哈薩爾，元太祖弟，今科爾沁六扎薩克，及紮賚特、杜爾伯特、郭爾羅斯、阿嚕科爾沁、四子部落、茂明安、烏喇特、阿拉善、青海和碩特，皆其裔。

translations.literal: The Khorchin founding ancestor was Khabutu Hasar, younger brother of the Yuan founding emperor; today's six Khorchin zasak, together with Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Alxa Khorchin, the Four Torghut Banners, Maoming'an, Urad, Alashan, and the Qinghai Khoshut—all are his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: The Khorchin traced their descent to Khabutu Hasar, Genghis Khan's younger brother. His line included the six Khorchin zasak banners as well as Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Alxa Khorchin, the Four Torghut Banners, Maoming'an, Urad, Alashan, and the Qinghai Khoshut.

sentences.zh: 哈布圖哈薩爾十四傳至奎蒙克塔斯哈喇，有子二：長博第達喇，號卓爾郭勒諾顏；

translations.literal: Khabutu Hasar's line passed through fourteen generations to Kuimengke Tasihara, who had two sons: the eldest, Boidara, styled Jorogol noyan;
translations.idiomatic: Fourteen generations after Khabutu Hasar came Kuimengke Tasihara, who had two sons: the elder Boidara, styled Jorogol noyan;

sentences.zh: 次諾捫達喇，號噶勒濟庫諾顏。

translations.literal: the younger, Nomunda, styled Galejiku noyan.
translations.idiomatic: and the younger Nomunda, styled Galejiku noyan.

sentences.zh: 博第達喇子九：長齊齊克，號巴圖爾諾顏，為土謝圖汗奧巴、扎薩克圖郡王布達齊二旗祖；

translations.literal: Boidara had nine sons: the eldest, Chichik, styled Batuur noyan, was ancestor of the two banners of Tüsiyetü Khan Obai and Jasaktu Prince Budari;
translations.idiomatic: Boidara had nine sons. The eldest, Chichik, styled Batuur noyan, was ancestor of the banners of Tüsiyetü Khan Obai and Jasaktu Prince Budari;

sentences.zh: 次納穆賽，號都喇勒諾顏，為達爾漢親王滿珠習禮、冰圖郡王洪果爾、貝勒棟果爾三旗祖；

translations.literal: the second, Namusai, styled Dural noyan, was ancestor of the three banners of Darchan Prince Manjusiri, Bintu Prince Honggoer, and Beile Donggoer;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Namusai, styled Dural noyan, was ancestor of the banners of Darchan Prince Manjusiri, Bintu Prince Honggoer, and Beile Donggoer;

sentences.zh: 次烏巴什，號鄂特歡諾顏，見郭爾羅斯傳；

translations.literal: the third, Ubash, styled Otohon noyan, is treated in the Gorlos biography;
translations.idiomatic: the third, Ubash, styled Otohon noyan, is treated in the Gorlos biography;

sentences.zh: 次烏延岱科托果爾；

translations.literal: the fourth, Uyandai Kotogor;
translations.idiomatic: the fourth, Uyandai Kotogor;

sentences.zh: 次托多巴圖爾喀喇；

translations.literal: the fifth, Todobaatur Kara;
translations.idiomatic: the fifth, Todobaatur Kara;

sentences.zh: 次拜新；

translations.literal: the sixth, Baixin;
translations.idiomatic: the sixth, Baixin;

sentences.zh: 次額勒濟格卓哩克圖，裔不著；

translations.literal: the seventh, Erlejige Joriktu, whose descendants are not recorded;
translations.idiomatic: the seventh, Erlejige Joriktu, whose line is not recorded further;

sentences.zh: 次愛納噶，號車臣諾顏，見杜爾伯特傳；

translations.literal: the eighth, Ainaga, styled Sechen noyan, is treated in the Dorbod biography;
translations.idiomatic: the eighth, Ainaga, styled Sechen noyan, is treated in the Dorbod biography;

sentences.zh: 次阿敏，號巴噶諾顏，見紮賚特傳。

translations.literal: the ninth, Amin, styled Baga noyan, is treated in the Jalaid biography.
translations.idiomatic: and the ninth, Amin, styled Baga noyan, is treated in the Jalaid biography.

sentences.zh: 諾捫達喇子一，曰哲格爾德，為扎薩克鎮國公喇嘛什希一旗祖。

translations.literal: Nomunda had one son, Jegerde, ancestor of the single banner of zasak Gushun-ejen Lama Shisi.
translations.idiomatic: Nomunda had one son, Jegerde, ancestor of the banner of zasak Gushun-ejen Lama Shisi.

sentences.zh: 蒙古強部有三：曰察哈爾；

translations.literal: Among the powerful Mongol departments there were three: Chakhar;
translations.idiomatic: Three Mongol powers dominated the steppe: Chakhar;

sentences.zh: 曰喀爾喀；

translations.literal: Khalkha;
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha;

sentences.zh: 曰衛拉特，即厄魯特。

translations.literal: and Oirat, that is, the Eleuths.
translations.idiomatic: and the Oirats, or Eleuths.

sentences.zh: 明洪熙間，科爾沁為衛拉特所破，避居嫩江，以同族有阿嚕科爾沁，號嫩江科爾沁以自別。

translations.literal: In the Hongxi reign of the Ming, Khorchin was broken by the Oirats and took refuge on the Nen River; because a kinsman held Alxa Khorchin, they styled themselves Nen River Khorchin to distinguish themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the Hongxi reign of the Ming the Oirats defeated the Khorchin, who withdrew to the Nen River. Because a related branch held Alxa Khorchin, they called themselves Nen River Khorchin to set themselves apart.

sentences.zh: 紮賚特、杜爾伯特、郭爾羅斯三部與同牧，服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: Jalaid, Dorbod, and Gorlos—the three departments—pastured together with them and submitted to Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: Jalaid, Dorbod, and Gorlos pastured with them and acknowledged Chakhar overlordship.

sentences.zh: 太祖癸巳年，科爾沁台吉齊齊克子翁果岱，納穆賽子莽古斯、明安等，隨葉赫部台吉布齋，糾哈達、烏拉、輝發、錫伯、卦爾察、珠舍裏、納殷諸部來侵，攻赫濟格城不下，陳兵古哷山。

translations.literal: In the guisi year of the Taizu reign, Khorchin taiji Chichik's son Onggodei, Namusai's sons Mangusi and Minggan, and others followed Yehe taiji Buksan in rallying Hada, Ula, Hoifa, Xibe, Gūwalgiya, Jusheli, Nayan, and other departments to invade; they failed to take Hejige city and deployed their troops at Mount Gule.
translations.idiomatic: In the guisi year of Taizu's reign, Onggodei son of Khorchin taiji Chichik, together with Mangusi and Minggan sons of Namusai and others, joined Yehe taiji Buksan in rallying Hada, Ula, Hoifa, Xibe, Gūwalgiya, Jusheli, Nayan, and other tribes in an invasion. They failed to take Hejige and encamped their forces at Mount Gule.

sentences.zh: 上親禦之，至紮喀路，諭諸將曰：「彼雖眾，皆烏合。

translations.literal: The emperor went in person to meet them; reaching Zhakalu Road, he instructed the generals, saying: "Though they are many, they are all a mob gathered together.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor marched out in person. At Zhakalu Road he told his generals, "They are numerous, but they are only a mob.

sentences.zh: 我以逸待勞，傷其一二台吉，眾自潰。」

translations.literal: We shall meet their fatigue with our rest; wound one or two of their taiji, and the masses will collapse of themselves."
translations.idiomatic: We shall meet their fatigue with rested troops; wound one or two of their taiji and the rest will scatter on their own."

sentences.zh: 命巴圖魯額亦都率百騎挑戰，葉赫諸部兵罷攻城來禦，逆擊之。

translations.literal: He ordered Batuur Eidu to lead a hundred horsemen to offer challenge; the Yehe coalition troops abandoned the siege and came to meet them, and he struck them in counterattack.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Batuur Eidu to lead a hundred horsemen forward in challenge. The Yehe coalition abandoned the siege to meet them, and the Qing forces struck back.

sentences.zh: 明安馬蹶，裸而遁，追至哈達部柴河寨南，俘獲甚眾。

translations.literal: Minggan's horse stumbled; he fled naked; the pursuit reached south of the Hada department's Chaihe stockade, and very many were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Minggan's horse stumbled and he fled naked. The pursuit carried as far as south of the Hada Chaihe stockade, and the Qing forces took a great number of prisoners.

sentences.zh: 戊申，征烏拉部，圍宜罕阿林城，翁果岱復助烏拉台吉布占泰，我師擊敗之。

translations.literal: In the wushen year, campaigning against the Ula department and besieging Yihanalin city, Onggodei again aided Ula taiji Bujantai; our army defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the wushen year the court campaigned against Ula and besieged Yihanalin. Onggodei again aided Ula taiji Bujantai, but the Qing army defeated them.

sentences.zh: 於是莽古斯、明安、翁果岱先後遣使乞好。

translations.literal: Thereupon Mangusi, Minggan, and Onggodei sent envoys one after another to sue for peace.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Mangusi, Minggan, and Onggodei sent envoys in turn to sue for peace.

sentences.zh: 天命九年，翁果岱子奧巴率族來歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianming, Onggodei's son Obai led his clan to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianming, Obai son of Onggodei led his people to submit.

sentences.zh: 尋為察哈爾所侵，我援之，解圍去。

translations.literal: Soon afterward they were attacked by Chakhar; we aided them and the siege was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Chakhar attacked them; Qing aid relieved the siege.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，會大軍征察哈爾。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiancong, they joined the great army in campaigning against Chakhar.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tiancong they joined the main army in the campaign against Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 三年，從征明，克遵化州，圍北京。

translations.literal: In the third year, they followed in the campaign against Ming, took Zunhua prefecture, and besieged Beijing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they followed the campaign against Ming, captured Zunhua, and joined the siege of Beijing.

sentences.zh: 五年，圍大淩河，降其將祖大壽。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, they besieged Dalinghe and induced its general Zu Dashou to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year they besieged Dalinghe and induced its commander Zu Dashou to surrender.

sentences.zh: 六年，從略大同、宣府邊。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, they followed in raiding the Datong and Xuanfu borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year they joined raids along the Datong and Xuanfu frontiers.

sentences.zh: 八年，復從征明。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, they again followed in the campaign against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they again joined campaigns against Ming.

sentences.zh: 十年春，大軍平察哈爾，獲元傳國玉璽。

translations.literal: In the spring of the tenth year, the great army pacified Chakhar and obtained the Yuan dynastic jade seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the tenth year the main army pacified Chakhar and recovered the Yuan dynastic jade seal.

sentences.zh: 奧巴子土謝圖濟農巴達禮偕台吉烏克善、滿珠習禮、布達齊、洪果爾、喇嘛什希、棟果爾，及紮賚特、杜爾伯特、郭爾羅斯、喀喇沁、土默特、敖漢、柰曼、巴林、紮嚕特、阿嚕科爾沁、翁牛特諸部長來賀捷。

translations.literal: Obai's son Tüsiyetü jinong Badari, together with taiji Uksan, Manjusiri, Budari, Honggoer, Lama Shisi, Donggoer, and the chiefs of Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Harqin, Tumed, Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jalut, Alxa Khorchin, and Ongniud, came to congratulate the victory.
translations.idiomatic: Obai's son Tüsiyetü jinong Badari came with taiji Uksan, Manjusiri, Budari, Honggoer, Lama Shisi, Donggoer, and the chiefs of Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Harqin, Tumed, Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jalut, Alxa Khorchin, and Ongniud to congratulate the victory.

sentences.zh: 以上功德隆，宜正位號，遺朝鮮國王書，示推戴意。

translations.literal: Because meritorious achievement was now lofty, it was fitting to assume the proper title; a letter was sent to the king of Korea showing the intent of elevation.
translations.idiomatic: Because the dynasty's achievements had reached their height, it was time to assume the imperial title; a letter was sent to the king of Korea announcing the plan for enthronement.

sentences.zh: 四月，合疏上尊號，改元崇德。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, a joint memorial presented the honorific title and the reign era was changed to Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the Mongol chiefs jointly presented the honorific title and the reign era was changed to Chongde.

sentences.zh: 禮成，敘功，詔科爾沁部設扎薩克五：曰巴達禮，曰滿珠習禮，曰布達齊，曰洪果爾，曰喇嘛什希，分領其眾，賜親王、郡王、鎮國公爵有差。

translations.literal: When the rites were completed, merit was reviewed; an edict established five zasak for the Khorchin department—Badari, Manjusiri, Budari, Honggoer, and Lama Shisi—to divide leadership of their people, with princedoms of qinwang, junwang, and gushun-ejen granted in differing ranks.
translations.idiomatic: After the enthronement rites, rewards were distributed. An edict established five Khorchin zasak—Badari, Manjusiri, Budari, Honggoer, and Lama Shisi—to divide leadership of the people, granting ranks from qinwang and junwang down to gushun-ejen.

sentences.zh: 十月，命大學士希福等赴其部，鞫罪犯，頒法律，禁奸盜，編佐領。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Grand Secretaries Xifu and others were ordered to go to their department to try criminals, promulgate laws, forbid treachery and theft, and organize zuoling.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Grand Secretaries Xifu and others were sent to the Khorchin lands to try criminals, promulgate laws, forbid treachery and theft, and organize zuoling companies.

sentences.zh: 二年，從征喀木尼堪部及朝鮮。

translations.literal: In the second year, they followed in campaigns against the Kamniikan department and Korea.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year they joined campaigns against the Kamniikan tribes and Korea.

sentences.zh: 三年，征喀爾喀。

translations.literal: In the third year, they campaigned against Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they campaigned against Khalkha.

sentences.zh: 四年春，征索倫。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, they campaigned against the Solon.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the fourth year they campaigned against the Solon.

sentences.zh: 秋，圍明杏山、高橋。

translations.literal: In autumn, they besieged Ming Xingshan and Gaoqiao.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they besieged the Ming fortresses of Xingshan and Gaoqiao.

sentences.zh: 八年，隨饒餘貝勒阿巴泰、護軍統領阿爾津征明及黑龍江諸部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, they followed Raoyu Beile Abatai and Guard Commander Arjin in campaigning against Ming and the Amur tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they followed Raoyu Beile Abatai and Guard Commander Arjin in campaigns against Ming and the Amur tribes.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，偕紮賚特、杜爾伯特、郭爾羅斯兵隨睿親王多爾袞入山海關，走流賊李自成，追至望都。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, together with Jalaid, Dorbod, and Gorlos troops, they followed Prince Regent Dorgon through Shanhai Pass, routed the rebel Li Zicheng, and pursued him to Wangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi, together with Jalaid, Dorbod, and Gorlos troops, they followed Prince Regent Dorgon through Shanhai Pass, routed Li Zicheng's rebels, and pursued them to Wangdu.

sentences.zh: 二年，隨豫親王多鐸定江南。

translations.literal: In the second year, they followed Prince Dodo in pacifying Jiangnan.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year they followed Prince Dodo in pacifying Jiangnan.

sentences.zh: 三年，復隨剿蘇尼特叛人騰機思，敗喀爾喀土謝圖汗、車臣汗援兵。

translations.literal: In the third year, they again followed in suppressing the Sunid rebel Tenggis, defeating the Khalkha Tüsiyetü Khan and Sechen Khan relief forces.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they again joined the suppression of the Sunid rebel Tenggis and defeated Khalkha relief forces led by the Tüsiyetü and Sechen khans.

sentences.zh: 七年，科爾沁復設扎薩克一，以棟果爾子彰吉倫領之，由貝勒晉郡王爵。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, one more zasak was established for Khorchin, with Donggoer's son Janggilun to lead it, advanced from beile to junwang rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year another Khorchin zasak was established under Donggoer's son Janggilun, who was promoted from beile to junwang.

sentences.zh: 十三年，上以科爾沁及紮賚特、杜爾伯特、郭爾羅斯、喀喇沁、土默特、敖漢、柰曼、巴林、紮嚕特、阿嚕科爾沁、翁牛特、烏珠穆沁、浩齊特、蘇尼特、阿巴噶、四子部落、烏喇特、喀爾喀左翼、鄂爾多斯諸扎薩克歸誠久，賜敕曰：「爾等秉資忠直，當太祖、太宗開創之初，誠心歸附，職效屏籓。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, because Khorchin and the zasak of Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Harqin, Tumed, Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jalut, Alxa Khorchin, Ongniud, Ujimqin, Khoqit, Sunid, Abaga, the Four Torghut Banners, Urad, Khalkha Left Wing, and Ordos had long submitted in sincerity, an imperial edict was granted, saying: "You are endowed with loyal uprightness; at the beginning of the Taizu and Taizong founding enterprise you submitted in sincere heart and performed the duty of screen and rampart.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the emperor, noting that Khorchin and the zasak of Jalaid, Dorbod, Gorlos, Harqin, Tumed, Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jalut, Alxa Khorchin, Ongniud, Ujimqin, Khoqit, Sunid, Abaga, the Four Torghut Banners, Urad, Khalkha Left Wing, and Ordos had long remained loyal, issued an edict: "You are by nature loyal and upright. At the founding of the dynasty under Taizu and Taizong you submitted in good faith and served as the dynasty's outer shield.

sentences.zh: 太祖、太宗嘉爾勳勞，崇封爵號，賞賚有加。

translations.literal: Taizu and Taizong commended your merit and toil, exalted your titles and ranks, and heaped rewards upon you.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu and Taizong praised your merit, raised your titles, and heaped rewards upon you.

sentences.zh: 朝覲貢獻，時令陛見，飲食教誨，為數甚多。

translations.literal: At court audiences and tribute missions you were summoned to audience in season; feasting, instruction, and admonition were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: You came to court for audiences and tribute, were summoned to audience in due season, and received feasts, instruction, and guidance again and again.

sentences.zh: 凡有懷欲吐，俱得陳奏，心意和諧，如同父子。

translations.literal: Whatever you wished to speak from the heart, you were all able to present in memorial; hearts and minds were in harmony, like father and son.
translations.idiomatic: Whatever you wished to say, you could present in memorial; our hearts were in harmony like father and son.

sentences.zh: 朕荷祖宗鴻庥，統一寰宇，恐於懿行有違，成憲未洽，恆用憂惕。

translations.literal: I have received the vast blessing of the ancestors and unified the realm; I fear that I may fall short of excellent conduct and that established statutes may not yet be fully applied, and therefore constantly feel anxious apprehension.
translations.idiomatic: I have received my ancestors' vast blessing and unified the realm, yet I fear I may fall short of their excellent conduct and that established statutes may not yet be fully applied, and so I live in constant anxiety.

sentences.zh: 親政以來，六年於茲，未得與爾等一見，雖因萬幾少暇，而懷爾之忱，時切朕念。

translations.literal: Since I took personal rule, six years have now passed, yet I have not been able to meet you once; though because of the myriad affairs I have little leisure, my regard for your sincerity is constantly urgent in my thoughts.
translations.idiomatic: Six years have passed since I took the throne, yet I have not met you once. Though the myriad affairs of state leave me little leisure, my regard for you has never left my mind.

sentences.zh: 每思爾等效力有年，功績卓著，雖在寤寐，未之有斁。

translations.literal: Whenever I think how you have served with effort for many years and your achievements are outstanding, even in waking and sleeping there is no weariness of this thought.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever I think of your years of loyal service and outstanding achievements, the thought stays with me waking and sleeping.

sentences.zh: 誠以爾等相見既疏，恐有壅蔽，不能上通，故特遣官齎敕賜幣，以諭朕意。

translations.literal: Truly because meetings with you have grown sparse, I fear there may be obstruction and that matters cannot reach me above; therefore I specially dispatch officials bearing the edict and bestowing gifts to make known my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Because we meet so seldom, I fear your concerns may be blocked from reaching me. I therefore send officials with this edict and gifts to make my intentions known.

sentences.zh: 嗣後有所欲請，隨時奏聞，朕無不體恤而行。

translations.literal: Hereafter, whatever you wish to request, report it at any time; I shall without exception consider it sympathetically and act upon it.
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter, whatever you wish to request, report it at any time and I shall consider it sympathetically and act upon it.

sentences.zh: 朕方思致天下於太平，爾等心懷忠藎，毋忘兩朝恩寵。

translations.literal: I am now thinking to bring the realm to great peace; you cherish loyal devotion in your hearts—do not forget the grace of the two reigns.
translations.idiomatic: I am working to bring the realm to peace. Keep your loyal hearts and do not forget the grace shown you by two reigns.

sentences.zh: 朕世世為天子，爾等亦世世為王，享富貴於無窮，垂芳名於不朽，不亦休乎！」

translations.literal: I shall be Son of Heaven generation after generation, and you likewise shall be kings generation after generation, enjoying wealth and honor without end and leaving a fragrant name that never perishes—is this not felicity!"
translations.idiomatic: I shall be Son of Heaven generation after generation, and you shall be kings generation after generation, enjoying endless wealth and honor and leaving an immortal name—is that not felicity!"

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，徵所部兵討逆籓吳三桂。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, troops of the department were levied to suppress the rebel Wu Sangui.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi the league levied its troops to suppress the rebel Wu Sangui.

sentences.zh: 十四年，剿察哈爾叛人布林尼。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, they suppressed the Chakhar rebel Burni.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year they helped suppress the Chakhar rebel Burni.

sentences.zh: 先是科爾沁內附，莽古斯以女歸太宗文皇帝，是為孝端文皇后。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Khorchin submitted within the frontier, Mangusi gave his daughter in marriage to Taizong the Wendi Emperor; she became Empress Xiaoduanwen.
translations.idiomatic: After Khorchin submitted, Mangusi gave his daughter in marriage to Taizong; she became Empress Xiaoduanwen.

sentences.zh: 孫烏克善等復以女弟來歸，是為孝莊文皇后。

translations.literal: The grandson Uksan and others again sent a younger sister in marriage; she became Empress Xiaozhuangwen.
translations.idiomatic: His grandson Uksan and others later sent another daughter of the clan; she became Empress Xiaozhuangwen.

sentences.zh: 曾孫綽爾濟復以女歸世祖章皇帝，是為孝惠章皇后。

translations.literal: The great-grandson Chuoerji again gave a daughter in marriage to Shizu the Zhang Emperor; she became Empress Xiaohuizhang.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandson Chuoerji gave another daughter to Shizu; she became Empress Xiaohuizhang.

sentences.zh: 科爾沁以列朝外戚，荷國恩獨厚，列內扎薩克二十四部首。

translations.literal: Because Khorchin was maternal kin through successive reigns and bore a uniquely heavy burden of imperial grace, it was ranked first among the twenty-four Inner Mongol zasak departments.
translations.idiomatic: As maternal kin through successive reigns, Khorchin enjoyed uniquely heavy imperial favor and ranked first among the twenty-four Inner Mongol zasak leagues.

sentences.zh: 有大征伐，必以兵從，如親征噶爾丹，及剿策妄阿喇布坦、羅卜藏丹津、噶爾丹策淩、達瓦齊諸役，扎薩克等效力戎行，莫不懋著勤勞。

translations.literal: Whenever there was a great campaign, troops were certainly sent to follow; such as the emperor's personal expedition against Galdan, and the suppression of Tsewang Arabtan, Lobsang Danjin, Galdan Tsering, Dawachi, and other operations—the zasak and others served in the army, none failing to display abundant merit and toil.
translations.idiomatic: On every major campaign they furnished troops—from the emperor's personal expedition against Galdan to the suppression of Tsewang Arabtan, Lobsang Danjin, Galdan Tsering, Dawachi, and others. The zasak and their men served in the field and distinguished themselves in every campaign.

sentences.zh: 土謝圖親王、達爾漢親王、卓哩克圖親王、扎薩克圖郡王四爵俸幣視他部獨增，非惟禮崇姻戚，抑以其功冠焉。

translations.literal: The four ranks of Tüsiyetü qinwang, Darchan qinwang, Joriktu qinwang, and Jasaktu junwang received stipends and gifts increased beyond other departments—not only because ritual honored affinal kin, but also because their achievements stood foremost.
translations.idiomatic: The four ranks of Tüsiyetü qinwang, Darchan qinwang, Joriktu qinwang, and Jasaktu junwang received stipends and gifts beyond those of other leagues—not only because ritual honored imperial affines, but because their achievements stood foremost.

sentences.zh: 所部六旗，分左右翼。

translations.literal: The department had six banners, divided into left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: The league comprised six banners divided into left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 土謝圖親王掌右翼，附紮賚特部一旗、杜爾伯特部一旗；

translations.literal: the Tüsiyetü qinwang governed the right wing, with one Jalaid banner and one Dorbod banner attached;
translations.idiomatic: The Tüsiyetü qinwang governed the right wing with one Jalaid and one Dorbod banner attached;

sentences.zh: 達爾漢親王掌左翼，附郭爾羅斯部二旗，統盟於哲裏木。

translations.literal: the Darchan qinwang governed the left wing, with two Gorlos banners attached, and the league was united at Jirem.
translations.idiomatic: the Darchan qinwang governed the left wing with two Gorlos banners attached, and the league was united at Jirem.

sentences.zh: 右翼中旗駐巴顏和翔，左翼中旗駐伊克唐噶哩克坡，右翼前旗駐席喇布林哈蘇，右翼後旗駐額木圖坡，左翼前旗駐伊嶽克裏泊，左翼後旗駐雙和爾山。

translations.literal: The right-wing central banner was stationed at Bayan Hexiang; the left-wing central banner at Ike Tanggalikpo; the right-wing front banner at Xilabulinhasu; the right-wing rear banner at Emetupo; the left-wing front banner at Iyeke Libo; the left-wing rear banner at Shuang He'ershan.
translations.idiomatic: The right-wing central banner was stationed at Bayan Hexiang; the left-wing central at Ike Tanggalikpo; the right-wing front at Xilabulinhasu; the right-wing rear at Emetupo; the left-wing front at Iyeke Libo; and the left-wing rear at Shuang He'ershan.

sentences.zh: 爵十有七：扎薩克和碩土謝圖親王一；

translations.literal: There were seventeen titles: one zasak heshuo Tüsiyetü qinwang;
translations.idiomatic: There were seventeen titles: one zasak heshuo Tüsiyetü qinwang;

sentences.zh: 附多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: with one attached duoluo beile;
translations.idiomatic: with one attached duoluo beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克和碩達爾漢親王一；

translations.literal: one zasak heshuo Darchan qinwang;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak heshuo Darchan qinwang;

sentences.zh: 附卓哩克圖親王一；

translations.literal: with one attached Joriktu qinwang;
translations.idiomatic: with one attached Joriktu qinwang;

sentences.zh: 多羅郡王二，一由親王降襲；

translations.literal: two duoluo junwang, one demoted by inheritance from qinwang;
translations.idiomatic: two duoluo junwang, one inherited by demotion from qinwang rank;

sentences.zh: 多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: one duoluo beile;
translations.idiomatic: one duoluo beile;

sentences.zh: 固山貝子一；

translations.literal: one gushan beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one gushan beizi;

sentences.zh: 輔國公四，一由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: four fuguo gong, one demoted by inheritance from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: four fuguo gong, one inherited by demotion from beizi rank;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅扎薩克圖郡王一；

translations.literal: one zasak duoluo Jasaktu junwang;
translations.idiomatic: and one zasak duoluo Jasaktu junwang.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅冰圖郡王一；

translations.literal: one zasak duoluo Bintu junwang;
translations.idiomatic: One zasak duoluo Bintu junwang;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅郡王一，由貝勒晉襲；

translations.literal: one zasak duoluo junwang, advanced by inheritance from beile;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak duoluo junwang, inherited by promotion from beile rank;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一，由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: with one attached fuguo gong, demoted by inheritance from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: with one attached fuguo gong, inherited by demotion from beizi rank;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克鎮國公一。

translations.literal: and one zasak gushun-ejen.
translations.idiomatic: and one zasak gushun-ejen.

sentences.zh: 左翼中旗扎薩克達爾漢親王滿珠習禮之玄孫色布騰巴勒珠爾，乾隆十一年三月尚固倫和敬公主。

translations.literal: Sebuteng Balzhuer, great-great-grandson of left-wing central banner zasak Darchan Prince Manjusiri, in the third month of the eleventh year of Qianlong married the Gurun Hejing Princess.
translations.idiomatic: Sebuteng Balzhuer, great-great-grandson of left-wing central banner zasak Darchan Prince Manjusiri, married the Gurun Hejing Princess in the third month of the eleventh year of Qianlong.

sentences.zh: 二十年，準噶爾之平，以功加雙俸，尋以阿睦爾撒納叛事，奪爵。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, when the Dzungars were pacified, he received double stipend for merit; soon afterward, because of the Amursana rebellion, his title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, after the pacification of the Dzungars, he received double stipend for his merit, but soon lost his title for involvement in the Amursana rebellion.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，復封和碩親王。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, he was again enfeoffed as heshuo qinwang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was restored to heshuo qinwang.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，與征金川，又以附富德劾阿桂，奪爵。

translations.literal: In the thirty-seventh year, he joined the Jinchuan campaign; again, for siding with Fu De in impeaching Agui, his title was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-seventh year he joined the Jinchuan campaign, but again lost his title for siding with Fu De in impeaching Agui.

sentences.zh: 四十年，復之。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, it was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year his title was restored.

sentences.zh: 四傳至棍楚克林沁，襲鎮國公，官至御前大臣，卒。

translations.literal: After four generations the line reached Gunchukelin, who inherited gushun-ejen, rose to Grand Minister in Attendance, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Four generations later Gunchukelin inherited the gushun-ejen title, rose to Grand Minister in Attendance, and died.

sentences.zh: 其後左翼中旗輔國公二，左翼後旗輔國公一，均停襲。

translations.literal: Thereafter two fuguo gong of the left-wing central banner and one fuguo gong of the left-wing rear banner all ceased inheritance.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter two fuguo gong titles in the left-wing central banner and one in the left-wing rear banner all lapsed for lack of heirs.

sentences.zh: 左翼後旗扎薩克多羅郡王僧格林沁，以軍功晉博多勒噶台和碩親王。

translations.literal: Left-wing rear banner zasak duoluo junwang Sengge Rinchen, for military merit was advanced to Boduoligatai heshuo qinwang.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen, zasak duoluo junwang of the left-wing rear banner, was promoted to Boduoligatai heshuo qinwang for military merit.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，予世襲罔替。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, perpetual hereditary succession was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi his line was granted perpetual hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 四年，以剿撚匪陣亡，自有傳。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, he died in battle suppressing Nian bandits; he has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he died in battle against the Nian rebels; his career is recorded in a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 其旗增多羅貝勒一，輔國公二，皆以僧格林沁功。

translations.literal: His banner gained one additional duoluo beile and two fuguo gong, all because of Sengge Rinchen's achievements.
translations.idiomatic: His banner gained one additional duoluo beile and two fuguo gong titles, all rewards for Sengge Rinchen's service.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁子伯彥訥謨祜，初封輔國公。

translations.literal: Sengge Rinchen's son Boyenemuhu was at first enfeoffed as fuguo gong.
translations.idiomatic: Sengge Rinchen's son Boyenemuhu was first enfeoffed as fuguo gong.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，晉貝勒。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tongzhi, he was advanced to beile.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tongzhi he was promoted to beile.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，襲博多勒噶台親王，為御前大臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year, he inherited the Boduoligatai princedom and became Grand Minister in Attendance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year he inherited the Boduoligatai princedom and became Grand Minister in Attendance.

sentences.zh: 十一月，命與左翼中旗扎薩克達爾漢親王索特那木朋蘇克等選馬隊剿奉天馬賊。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he was ordered, together with left-wing central banner zasak Darchan Prince Sotenompengsuke and others, to select cavalry to suppress Fengtian horse bandits.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he was ordered, together with left-wing central banner zasak Darchan Prince Sotenompengsuke and others, to raise cavalry and suppress horse bandits in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，大破馬賊于鄭家屯。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, he inflicted a great defeat on the horse bandits at Zhengjiatun.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year he inflicted a major defeat on the horse bandits at Zhengjiatun.

sentences.zh: 三月，命捕吉林餘匪。

translations.literal: In the third month, he was ordered to capture the remaining bandits in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month he was ordered to hunt down the remaining bandits in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 六月，條陳奉天善後事宜，詔如所請行。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, he memorialized item by item on postwar arrangements in Fengtian; an edict approved his requests.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he submitted a detailed plan for postwar recovery in Fengtian, and the court approved his proposals.

sentences.zh: 匪平，回京。

translations.literal: When the bandits were pacified, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: After the bandits were suppressed he returned to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，德宗典學，命在毓慶宮行走，授兼鑲黃旗領侍衛內大臣。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangxu, when the Dezong Emperor began his studies, he was ordered to attend at the Yuqing Palace and was appointed concurrent Bordered Yellow Banner Chief Guard and Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Guangxu reign, when the Guangxu Emperor began his studies, he was assigned to the Yuqing Palace and appointed concurrent Bordered Yellow Banner Chief Guard and Grand Minister of the Imperial Bodyguard.

sentences.zh: 十七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventeenth year.

sentences.zh: 自道光季年海防事起，洎咸豐三年粵逆北犯，八年海防又急，皆調東三盟兵協同防剿，科爾沁部為之冠，予爵職、給廕襲者，皆甲諸部。

translations.literal: From the late Daoguang period when coastal defense affairs arose, down through the third year of Xianfeng when the Cantonese rebels invaded northward, and the eighth year when coastal defense was again urgent—all summoned troops of the eastern three leagues for joint defense and suppression, with the Khorchin department foremost; titles granted and hereditary privileges given ranked first among all departments.
translations.idiomatic: From the late Daoguang period, when coastal defense became urgent, through the third year of Xianfeng when the Taiping rebels marched north and the eighth year when the coast was threatened again, the court repeatedly called up troops from the eastern three leagues. Khorchin always led the rest, and its rewards of titles and hereditary privileges ranked first among all the leagues.

sentences.zh: 僧格林沁之亡，始撤哲裏木盟兵旋所部。

translations.literal: Only after Sengge Rinchen's death were the Jirem league troops withdrawn to their own departments.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Sengge Rinchen's death were the Jirem league troops withdrawn to their home banners.

sentences.zh: 初，科爾沁諸旗以距奉天近，皆招佃內地民人開墾。

translations.literal: At first, because the Khorchin banners lay close to Fengtian, all recruited tenant farmers from the interior to open land for cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: At first, because the Khorchin banners lay close to Fengtian, they all recruited Han tenant farmers from the interior to open land for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十九年，盛京將軍永瑋等奏：「賓圖王旗界內所留民人近鐵嶺者，達爾漢王旗所留民人近開原者，即交鐵嶺縣、開原縣治之。」

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong, Mukden General Yongwei and others memorialized: "The settlers retained within Bintu Prince's banner near Tieling, and those retained within Darchan Prince's banner near Kaiyuan, should be placed under the jurisdiction of Tieling and Kaiyuan counties."
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-ninth year of Qianlong Mukden General Yongwei memorialized that settlers within Bintu Prince's banner near Tieling and within Darchan Prince's banner near Kaiyuan should be placed under Tieling and Kaiyuan county administration.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶十一年十月，盛京將軍富俊等以左翼後旗昌圖額勒克地方招墾閒荒，經歷四載，人民四萬有奇，請增置理事通判治之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Jiaqing, Mukden General Fujun and others reported that the left-wing rear banner had recruited cultivation of idle land at Changtu Elege; over four years the population exceeded forty thousand, and they requested an additional supervising subprefect to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eleventh year of Jiaqing, Mukden General Fujun reported that the left-wing rear banner had opened idle land at Changtu Elege; in four years the population exceeded forty thousand, and he requested a supervising subprefect to govern the settlers.

sentences.zh: 達爾漢王旗界內所留人民，亦交通判就近並治，時諸旗扎薩克、王、公等多招民人墾荒，積欠抗租，則又請驅逐。

translations.literal: The settlers retained within Darchan Prince's banner were also to be jointly governed by a nearby subprefect; at the time many zasak, princes, and dukes of the banners recruited settlers to open wasteland, and when rent arrears mounted and tenants resisted payment, they would again request expulsion.
translations.idiomatic: Settlers within Darchan Prince's banner were to be governed by the same subprefect. Meanwhile many banner zasak, princes, and dukes recruited Han farmers to open wasteland, then petitioned for their expulsion when rents fell into arrears.

sentences.zh: 廷議非之，嚴定招墾之禁，已佃者不得逐，未墾者不得招。

translations.literal: Court deliberation rejected this; recruitment for cultivation was strictly forbidden—those already settled might not be expelled, and wasteland might not be newly recruited.
translations.idiomatic: The court rejected these petitions and strictly regulated land opening: settlers already in place could not be expelled, but no new recruitment was permitted.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，左翼中旗扎薩克達爾漢親王布彥溫都爾瑚竟以墾事延不就鞫，奪扎薩克。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daoguang, left-wing central banner zasak Darchan Prince Buyanwenduerhu, because of cultivation affairs, repeatedly delayed appearing for trial and lost his zasak post.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daoguang, left-wing central banner zasak Darchan Prince Buyanwenduerhu repeatedly evaded trial over illegal land opening and was stripped of his zasak post.

sentences.zh: 然私放私墾者仍日有所增，流民游匪於焉麕集。

translations.literal: Yet unauthorized leasing and cultivation still increased day by day, and drifting people and roaming bandits gathered there in herds.
translations.idiomatic: Yet unauthorized leasing and cultivation continued to spread, and drifting settlers and roaming bandits gathered there in growing numbers.

sentences.zh: 同治中，以昌圖匪亂，通判秩輕，升為理事同知。

translations.literal: During Tongzhi, because of bandit turmoil at Changtu, the subprefect's rank was deemed too low and the post was raised to supervising prefect.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tongzhi reign, after bandit unrest at Changtu, the subprefect's rank was deemed too low and the post was raised to supervising prefect.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，署盛京將軍崇厚奏設官撫治，以清盜源。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu, acting Mukden General Chonghou memorialized to establish officials for pacification and governance, to eliminate the source of banditry.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Guangxu acting Mukden General Chonghou memorialized for official administration to suppress the root causes of banditry.

sentences.zh: 遂升昌圖同知為府，以原墾達爾漢王旗之梨樹城、八面城地置奉化、懷德二縣隸之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Changtu prefect was raised to a fu, and on land originally cultivated in Darchan Prince's banner at Lishucheng and Bamian Cheng, Fenghua and Huaide counties were established under it.
translations.idiomatic: Changtu was then raised to a prefecture, and Fenghua and Huaide counties were established on land originally opened in Darchan Prince's banner at Lishucheng and Bamian Cheng.

sentences.zh: 七年，又設康平縣于康家屯，隸之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Kangping county was also established at Kangjiatun under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Kangping county was established at Kangjiatun under the same prefecture.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，盛京將軍增祺奏設遼源州于蘇家屯，隸之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Mukden General Zengqi memorialized to establish Liaoyuan prefecture at Sujiatun under its jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-eighth year Mukden General Zengqi established Liaoyuan prefecture at Sujiatun under the same administration.

sentences.zh: 皆治左翼三旗墾民。

translations.literal: All governed the cultivating settlers of the three left-wing banners.
translations.idiomatic: All administered Han settlers on the three left-wing banners.

sentences.zh: 是年，右翼前旗扎薩克圖郡王烏泰以放荒事屢被劾，命禮部尚書裕德會增祺勘治。

translations.literal: That year, right-wing front banner Jasaktu Prince Utai was repeatedly impeached over land-opening affairs; Minister of Rites Yude was ordered to join Zengqi in investigation and settlement.
translations.idiomatic: That year right-wing front banner Jasaktu Prince Utai was repeatedly impeached over illegal land opening; Minister of Rites Yude was ordered to investigate jointly with Zengqi.

sentences.zh: 四月，覆奏言：「烏泰已放荒界南北長三百餘里，東西寬一百餘里，外來客民有一千二百六十餘戶。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, their reply memorial stated: "The land Utai has already opened measures more than three hundred li north to south and more than one hundred li east to west; outside tenant households number more than one thousand two hundred and sixty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month their reply stated that Utai had opened land more than three hundred li from north to south and more than one hundred li from east to west, with more than 1,260 outside tenant households.

sentences.zh: 烏泰不諳放荒章程，以致嗜利之徒，任意墾占，轉相私售，實已暗增數千餘戶，新開荒地又增長三百餘里，寬一百餘里。

translations.literal: Utai did not understand land-opening regulations, so profit-seekers encroached at will, reselling plots in secret; in fact several thousand households were added covertly, and newly opened wasteland extended another three hundred-odd li in length and one hundred-odd li in width.
translations.idiomatic: Utai did not understand the regulations, so profiteers encroached at will and resold plots in secret. In fact several thousand households had been added covertly, and newly opened land extended another three hundred li in length and one hundred li in width.

sentences.zh: 梅楞齊莫特、色楞等復袒護荒戶，阻台吉壯丁在新放荒地遊牧。

translations.literal: Melengqimote, Seleng, and others further shielded wasteland tenants and obstructed taiji and strong youths from pasturing on newly opened land.
translations.idiomatic: Melengqimote, Seleng, and others shielded the settlers and blocked taiji and banner troops from pasturing on the newly opened land.

sentences.zh: 協理台吉巴圖濟爾噶勒遂以斂財聚眾，不恤旗艱，控之理籓院。

translations.literal: Associate taiji Batujiergale then amassed wealth and gathered followers, heedless of the banner's hardship, and lodged a complaint at the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Associate taiji Batujiergale amassed wealth and followers without regard for the banner's welfare and lodged a complaint at the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 經傳集烏泰等親自宣導，均各悔悟，原湔洗前愆，驅除讒慝，和同辦理旗務。

translations.literal: After summons and assembly, Utai and others personally instructed them; all repented, wished to wash away former faults, drive out slanderous villains, and manage banner affairs in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: After Utai and others were summoned and instructed them in person, all repented, wished to make amends, remove troublemakers, and manage banner affairs harmoniously.

sentences.zh: 請將烏泰、巴圖濟爾噶勒暫革，仍准留任，勒限三年，限滿經理得宜，由闔旗呈請開復，否則永遠革任；

translations.literal: It was requested that Utai and Batujiergale be temporarily dismissed yet allowed to remain in office, with a three-year deadline; if at the deadline management proved sound, the whole banner might petition for restoration, otherwise dismissal would be permanent;
translations.idiomatic: They requested that Utai and Batujiergale be temporarily suspended but allowed to remain in office for three years; if management proved sound the banner could petition for restoration, otherwise dismissal would be permanent;

sentences.zh: 齊莫特、色楞等均分別屏黜，不准干預旗務。

translations.literal: Qimote, Seleng, and others were each separately removed and forbidden to interfere in banner affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Qimote, Seleng, and others were removed and forbidden to interfere in banner affairs.

sentences.zh: 並為定領荒招墾章程，荒價則一半報效國家，一半歸之蒙旗。

translations.literal: Regulations were also fixed for surveying wasteland and recruiting cultivation; wasteland price was half presented to the state and half returned to the Mongol banner.
translations.idiomatic: They also fixed regulations for surveying wasteland and recruiting settlers; half the land price went to the state and half to the Mongol banner.

sentences.zh: 升科則每晌以中錢二百四十為籌餉設官等經費，以四百二十作蒙古生計，自王府至台吉、壯丁、喇嘛，各有得數。

translations.literal: For tax assessment, each shang was assessed two hundred and forty zhongqian for military funds and official expenses, and four hundred and twenty for Mongol livelihood; from the princely mansion down to taiji, strong youths, and lamas, each received a fixed share.
translations.idiomatic: For taxation each shang was assessed 240 zhongqian for military and official expenses and 420 for Mongol livelihood; from the princely mansion down to taiji, banner troops, and lamas, each received a fixed share.

sentences.zh: 仍酌留餘荒，講求牧養。」

translations.literal: Remaining wasteland was still set aside in due measure for pasturage."
translations.idiomatic: A portion of wasteland was still reserved for pasture.

sentences.zh: 均報可。

translations.literal: All was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved all of these proposals.

sentences.zh: 十月，增祺又奏勘明是旗洮爾河南北已墾未墾之地，約有一千餘萬畝，派員設局丈放。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Zengqi again memorialized that north and south of the Taoer River in this banner, land already cultivated and not yet cultivated amounted to about ten million mu; officials were dispatched to establish a bureau for survey and release.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Zengqi reported that north and south of the Taoer River in this banner, cultivated and uncultivated land totaled about ten million mu, and officials were sent to survey and allocate it.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以其地置洮南府，並置靖安、開通二縣隸之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Taonan fu was established on this land, with Jing'an and Kaitong counties placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year Taonan prefecture was established there, with Jing'an and Kaitong counties under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，盛京將軍趙爾巽以右翼後鎮國公旗墾地置安廣縣，而法庫門舊為左翼中達爾漢王諸旗招墾地，亦置同知治之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Mukden General Zhao Erxun established Anguang county on cultivated land of the right-wing rear gushun-ejen banner; Faku Gate, formerly land recruited for cultivation by the left-wing central Darchan Prince and related banners, also received a supervising prefect to govern it.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year Mukden General Zhao Erxun established Anguang county on cultivated land of the right-wing rear gushun-ejen banner, and Faku—formerly opened by the left-wing central Darchan Prince and related banners—also received a supervising prefect.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，東三省總督徐世昌以右翼中旗和碩土謝圖親王墾地置醴泉等縣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, Three Eastern Provinces Governor-General Xu Shichang established Liquan and other counties on cultivated land of the right-wing central banner heshuo Tüsiyetü Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year Three Eastern Provinces Governor-General Xu Shichang established Liquan and other counties on land cultivated by the right-wing central banner heshuo Tüsiyetü Prince.

sentences.zh: 於是科爾沁六旗墾地幾遍，郡縣亦最多，諸扎薩克王公等得租豐溢，而化沙礫為膏沃，地方亦日臻富庶。

translations.literal: Thereupon cultivated land nearly covered all six Khorchin banners, and their prefectures and counties were also the most numerous; the zasak princes and dukes obtained overflowing rent, gravel and sand were transformed into fertile soil, and the region daily grew prosperous.
translations.idiomatic: Cultivated land soon covered nearly all six Khorchin banners, which had more counties than any other league. Zasak princes and dukes drew abundant rents, gravel plains turned fertile, and the region grew steadily prosperous.

sentences.zh: 諸扎薩克王公等世次皆見表，惟右翼和碩土謝圖親王色旺諾爾布桑寶以庚子之變，中外多故，殞於非命。

translations.literal: The successive generations of all zasak princes and dukes appear in the tables; only right-wing heshuo Tüsiyetü Prince Sewennorbuzanbao, because of the disorders of the gengzi year and many troubles at home and abroad, died by violent misfortune.
translations.idiomatic: The successive generations of all zasak princes and dukes appear in the tables; only right-wing heshuo Tüsiyetü Prince Sewennorbuzanbao died violently amid the turmoil of the 1900 crisis and the troubles at home and abroad.

sentences.zh: 裕德等勘奏，謂為屬員逼勒而死，因請治偪勒者如律。

translations.literal: Yude and others investigated and memorialized that he had been compelled to death by subordinates, and therefore requested that the compellers be punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Yude's investigation concluded that subordinates had driven him to his death, and they requested legal punishment for those responsible.

sentences.zh: 尋增祺奏以族子業喜海順承襲，傳爵如故。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Zengqi memorialized that his clansman Yexihai should inherit in orderly succession, transmitting the title as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Zengqi memorialized that the title should pass in orderly succession to his clansman Yexihai.

sentences.zh: 凡蒙旗，扎薩克為一旗之長，制如一品，與都統等。

translations.literal: In all Mongol banners, the zasak is head of a banner, ranked as first grade, equal to a military governor.
translations.idiomatic: In every Mongol banner the zasak is the banner chief, ranked at first grade and equal to a military governor.

sentences.zh: 其輔曰協理台吉。

translations.literal: His assistant is called associate taiji.
translations.idiomatic: His deputy is the associate taiji.

sentences.zh: 屬曰管旗章京，副章京，參領，佐領。

translations.literal: Subordinates are called banner-managing zhangjing, deputy zhangjing, company commanders, and platoon leaders.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate officers include the banner-managing zhangjing, deputy zhangjing, company commanders, and platoon leaders.

sentences.zh: 蒙語管旗章京曰梅楞，參領曰劄蘭，佐領曰蘇木。

translations.literal: In Mongol, banner-managing zhangjing is called meileng, company commander is jalan, and platoon leader is sumu.
translations.idiomatic: In Mongol the banner-managing zhangjing is called meileng, the company commander jalan, and the platoon leader sumu.

sentences.zh: 蘇木實分治土地人民。

translations.literal: The sumu in fact divides governance of land and people.
translations.idiomatic: The sumu is the unit that actually administers land and people.

sentences.zh: 其佐領之額，右翼中旗二十二，左翼中旗四十六，右翼前旗、後旗均十六，左翼前旗、後旗均三。

translations.literal: The quota of platoon leaders: right-wing central banner twenty-two, left-wing central forty-six, right-wing front and rear banners sixteen each, left-wing front and rear three each.
translations.idiomatic: Platoon leader quotas were: twenty-two for the right-wing central banner, forty-six for the left-wing central, sixteen each for the right-wing front and rear banners, and three each for the left-wing front and rear.

sentences.zh: 凡哲裏木盟重大事件，科爾沁六旗以近奉天，故由盛京將軍專奏。

translations.literal: For all major affairs of the Jirem league, because the six Khorchin banners lie near Fengtian, the Mukden General reports separately.
translations.idiomatic: For major affairs of the Jirem league, the six Khorchin banners—being near Fengtian—report directly to the Mukden General.

sentences.zh: 郭爾羅斯前旗一旗以近吉林，郭爾羅斯後旗、紮賚特、杜爾伯特三旗以近黑龍江，故各由其省將軍專奏。

translations.literal: Gorlos front banner, being near Jilin, and Gorlos rear banner together with Jalaid and Dorbod, being near Heilongjiang, each report separately to their provincial generals.
translations.idiomatic: Gorlos front banner reports to the Jilin general; Gorlos rear, Jalaid, and Dorbod report to the Heilongjiang general.

sentences.zh: 紮賚特部，元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾十五傳至博第達喇，有子九，阿敏其季也。

translations.literal: The Jalaid department: Khabutu Hasar, younger brother of the Yuan founding emperor, passed through fifteen generations to Boidara, who had nine sons; Amin was the youngest.
translations.idiomatic: The Jalaid league descended from Khabutu Hasar, Genghis Khan's younger brother. Fifteen generations later came Boidara, who had nine sons; Amin was the youngest.

sentences.zh: 與兄齊齊克、納穆賽等鄰牧，號所部曰紮賚特。

translations.literal: Pasturing alongside his elder brothers Chichik, Namusai, and others, he styled his people Jalaid.
translations.idiomatic: Pasturing alongside his elder brothers Chichik and Namusai, he styled his people Jalaid.

sentences.zh: 天命九年，阿敏子蒙袞偕科爾沁台吉奧巴遣使乞好，優詔答之，遂率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianming, Amin's son Menggun, together with Khorchin taiji Obai, sent envoys to sue for peace; an edict answered them favorably, and they then led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianming, Amin's son Menggun and Khorchin taiji Obai sent envoys to sue for peace. The court responded favorably, and they led their followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，授蒙袞子色棱扎薩克，以與科爾沁同祖，附之，隸哲裏木盟。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi, Menggun's son Seleng was appointed zasak; because he shared ancestry with Khorchin, he was attached to them and enrolled in the Jirem league.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shunzhi Menggun's son Seleng was appointed zasak. Sharing ancestry with Khorchin, he was attached to them and enrolled in the Jirem league.

sentences.zh: 旗一，駐圖卜紳察罕坡。

translations.literal: One banner, stationed at Tubinschahanpo.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised one banner, stationed at Tubinschahanpo.

sentences.zh: 其爵為扎薩克多羅貝勒，由固山貝子晉襲。

translations.literal: Its title is zasak duoluo beile, advanced by inheritance from gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: Its title was zasak duoluo beile, inherited by promotion from gushan beizi rank.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十五年，黑龍江將軍恩澤等奏：「以戶部咨，黑龍江副都統壽山條奏，請放蒙古各旗荒地，派員赴紮賚特旗剴切勸商，原將屬界南接郭爾羅斯前旗，東濱嫩江之四家子、二龍梭口等處，指出開放，南北約長三百餘里，東西寬百餘里或三四十里，設局勘辦。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Guangxu, Heilongjiang General Enze and others memorialized: "Following the Board of Revenue consultation, Heilongjiang Deputy Military Governor Shoushan memorialized item by item requesting the opening of wasteland in all Mongol banners; officials should be sent to the Jalaid banner to urge earnest negotiation. Originally within its borders, south adjoining Gorlos front banner and east along the Nen River at Sijiazi, Erlongsuokou, and other places, areas were designated for opening—about three hundred-odd li north to south and one hundred-odd or thirty to forty li east to west—and a bureau was set up for survey and handling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Guangxu Heilongjiang General Enze memorialized that, following the Board of Revenue and Deputy Governor Shoushan's proposal to open Mongol wasteland, officials should be sent to negotiate with the Jalaid banner. Land south of Gorlos front banner and east along the Nen at Sijiazi and Erlongsuokou—about three hundred li north to south and thirty to one hundred li east to west—was designated for opening under a survey bureau.

sentences.zh: 並謂若大東以至大西，使沿邊各蒙旗均能招民墾荒，則強富可期，即可無北鄙之驚。」

translations.literal: It was also said that if from the far east to the far west all frontier Mongol banners could recruit settlers to open wasteland, strength and wealth could be expected, and alarm on the northern frontier could be avoided."
translations.idiomatic: They argued that if frontier Mongol banners from east to west could recruit settlers, the border would grow strong and wealthy and northern alarms could be avoided.

sentences.zh: 下所司議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the responsible offices for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was referred to the responsible offices for implementation.

sentences.zh: 先是哲裏木盟諸旗皆以禁墾甲令過嚴，無敢明言招墾者，至是始接踵開放雲。

translations.literal: Earlier, all banners of the Jirem league, because prohibition on cultivation was too strict, dared not openly speak of recruiting settlers; only now did openings follow one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Jirem league banners had not dared openly recruit settlers under strict prohibition orders; only now did land opening spread in succession.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，以墾地置大賚廳治之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, cultivated land was placed under the governance of Dazhai subprefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year cultivated land was placed under Dazhai subprefecture.

sentences.zh: 是部有佐領十六。

translations.literal: This department has sixteen platoon leaders.
translations.idiomatic: This league had sixteen platoon leaders.

sentences.zh: 杜爾伯特部，在喜峰口外，至京師二千五十里。

translations.literal: The Dorbod department lies beyond Xifeng Pass, two thousand and fifty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Dorbod league lay beyond Xifeng Pass, two thousand and fifty li from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 東西距百七十里，南北距二百四十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures one hundred and seventy li; north to south two hundred and forty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured one hundred and seventy li from east to west and two hundred and forty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 東及北皆黑龍江，西紮賚特，南郭爾羅斯，北界索倫籓部。

translations.literal: East and north are the Amur; west is Jalaid; south is Gorlos; north borders Solon frontier dependencies.
translations.idiomatic: The Amur lay to the east and north, Jalaid to the west, Gorlos to the south, and Solon frontier dependencies to the north.

sentences.zh: 蒙古稱杜爾伯特部者二，同名異族。

translations.literal: Among Mongols there are two called the Dorbod department, same name but different peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Mongols recognize two groups called Dorbod, sharing a name but of different origin.

sentences.zh: 一姓鮮囉斯，為衛拉特台吉孛罕裔，旗十有四，駐牧烏蘭古木，稱外扎薩克，別有傳。

translations.literal: One bears the surname Khorlos, descendants of Oirat taiji Bohan, with fourteen banners pasturing at Ulanqab, called Outer Zasak, treated in a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: One, of the Khorlos surname and descended from Oirat taiji Bohan, had fourteen banners pasturing at Ulanqab; as Outer Zasak they are treated in a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 一姓博爾濟吉特，為元太祖弟哈布圖哈薩爾裔，即今駐牧喜峰口外之內劄薩克也。

translations.literal: One bears the surname Borjigit, descendants of the Yuan founding emperor's younger brother Khabutu Hasar—that is, today's Inner Zasak pasturing beyond Xifeng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: The other, of Borjigit descent from Khabutu Hasar, is the Inner Zasak league pasturing beyond Xifeng Pass treated here.

sentences.zh: 哈布圖哈薩爾十六傳至愛納噶，始以名其部。

translations.literal: Khabutu Hasar's line passed through sixteen generations to Ainaga, who first gave his name to the department.
translations.idiomatic: Sixteen generations after Khabutu Hasar came Ainaga, who first gave his name to the league.

sentences.zh: 天命九年，愛納噶子阿都齊偕科爾沁台吉奧巴遣使乞好，優詔答之，遂率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianming, Ainaga's son Aduci, together with Khorchin taiji Obai, sent envoys to sue for peace; an edict answered favorably, and they led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianming, Ainaga's son Aduci and Khorchin taiji Obai sent envoys to sue for peace. The court responded favorably, and they led their followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，授阿都齊子色稜扎薩克，以與科爾沁同祖，附之，隸哲裏木盟。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi, Aduci's son Seleng was appointed zasak; because he shared ancestry with Khorchin, he was attached to them and enrolled in the Jirem league.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Shunzhi Aduci's son Seleng was appointed zasak, attached to Khorchin as a fellow descendant of Khabutu Hasar, and enrolled in the Jirem league.

sentences.zh: 旗一，駐多克多爾坡。

translations.literal: One banner, stationed at Dokdorepo.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised one banner, stationed at Dokdorepo.

sentences.zh: 其爵為扎薩克固山貝子。

translations.literal: Its title is zasak gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: Its title was zasak gushan beizi.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，杜爾伯特貝子貢噶綽克坦咨黑龍江將軍，請將交界重立封堆。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi, Dorbod beizi Gungachoktan consulted the Heilongjiang General, requesting that border markers be re-established at the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Tongzhi Dorbod beizi Gungachoktan asked the Heilongjiang general to re-establish border markers.

sentences.zh: 尋勘明：「巴勒該岡以北黑龍江界內，有杜爾伯特蒙人等居屯四處，牌莫多以南杜爾伯特界內，有黑龍江省屬人等居屯八處，舊界所占均系曠地，應准各就其所，以安生計。

translations.literal: Soon the survey clarified: "North of Balegaigang within Heilongjiang's border, Dorbod Mongols and others occupy four settlements; south of Paimoduo within Dorbod's border, Heilongjiang provincial subjects occupy eight settlements. The old boundary occupied only vacant land; each side should be allowed to remain where they are to secure livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: A survey found that north of Balegaigang within Heilongjiang were four Dorbod settlements, and south of Paimoduo within Dorbod were eight Heilongjiang settlements on what had been vacant land. Each side was allowed to remain where they were.

sentences.zh: 蒙古越占巴勒該岡地，應將南榆樹改為新界，省屬人等越占牌莫多地，應將四六山改為新界，共立界堆十七。」

translations.literal: Where Mongols had encroached north of Balegaigang, Nanyushu should become the new boundary; where provincial subjects had encroached south of Paimoduo, Siliushan should become the new boundary; seventeen border markers were jointly erected."
translations.idiomatic: Where Mongols had encroached north of Balegaigang, Nanyushu became the new boundary; where provincial subjects had encroached south of Paimoduo, Siliushan became the new boundary; seventeen markers were erected.

sentences.zh: 奏入，詔如議。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted; an edict approved as proposed.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 四年，貢噶綽克坦復咨以所立界堆將蒙古田地草廠歸入省界，有碍蒙古生計。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Gungachoktan again consulted that the erected markers had placed Mongol fields and pasture within the provincial border, harming Mongol livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Gungachoktan complained that the new markers had placed Mongol fields and pasture within the provincial border, harming Mongol livelihood.

sentences.zh: 詔派副都統克蒙額與哲裏木盟長及杜爾伯特會勘，劃還塔爾歡屯以東第十、第十一封堆之西蒙古墳塋房基，平毀二十顆樹封堆之南蒙界旗屯房屋，又增立界堆十有九，並以牌莫多以南官屯舊占蒙屯較巴勒該岡以北蒙屯舊占省屯多地十三里，撥二十顆樹封堆之南省屬空閒地如數補之。

translations.literal: An edict dispatched Deputy Military Governor Kemenge, together with the Jirem league chief and Dorbod, for joint survey; Mongol graveyards and house foundations west of the tenth and eleventh markers east of Taerhuantun were returned; houses of banner settlements south of the twenty-tree marker on the Mongol side were leveled; nineteen additional markers were erected; and because official settlements south of Paimoduo had long occupied more Mongol land than Mongol settlements north of Balegaigang had occupied provincial land—by thirteen li—vacant provincial land south of the twenty-tree marker was allotted in equal measure to compensate.
translations.idiomatic: Deputy Governor Kemenge was sent with the Jirem league chief and Dorbod to resurvey. Mongol graveyards west of markers ten and eleven east of Taerhuantun were returned; Mongol houses south of the twenty-tree marker were removed; nineteen new markers were added; and because official settlements south of Paimoduo had occupied thirteen li more Mongol land than Mongols had occupied provincial land north of Balegaigang, vacant provincial land south of the twenty-tree marker was allotted to compensate.

sentences.zh: 七年六月奏結，請飭貝子貢噶綽克坦嚴約屬人照界永遠遵守，報可。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year the case was concluded in memorial, requesting that beizi Gungachoktan strictly instruct his followers to observe the boundary forever; approval was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year the case was closed with orders that beizi Gungachoktan strictly instruct his followers to observe the boundary permanently.

sentences.zh: 十年，以是旗私招民人墾荒，嚴申禁令，革其協理台吉。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, because this banner privately recruited settlers to open wasteland, the prohibition was strictly reiterated and its associate taiji was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year the banner was rebuked for privately recruiting settlers to open wasteland, and its associate taiji was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十五年，將軍恩澤以招墾蒙地，關邊圉富強大計，復奏派員商勸放墾。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year of Guangxu, General Enze, because recruiting cultivation on Mongol land concerned the great plan of frontier strength and prosperity, again memorialized to dispatch officials to negotiate and urge land opening.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year of Guangxu General Enze again memorialized to send officials to negotiate land opening, arguing that cultivating Mongol land was essential to frontier strength.

sentences.zh: 時東三省鐵路之約既成，是部當鐵路之沖，交涉煩多，商民萃集。

translations.literal: At that time the railway treaty for the three eastern provinces had been concluded; this department lay athwart the railway route, foreign dealings were numerous, and merchants and settlers gathered.
translations.idiomatic: By then the Three Eastern Provinces railway treaty was in effect. The league lay on the main railway line, foreign dealings multiplied, and merchants and settlers gathered thickly.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，因以所部墾地置安達廳治之，隸黑龍江。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, because of cultivated land within its jurisdiction, Anda subprefecture was established to govern it, subordinate to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year cultivated land within its jurisdiction was placed under Anda subprefecture, subordinate to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 是部一旗，有佐領二十五。

translations.literal: This department has one banner, with twenty-five platoon leaders.
translations.idiomatic: The league comprised one banner with twenty-five platoon leaders.

sentences.zh: 郭爾羅斯部，在喜峰口外，至京師千八百九十七里。

translations.literal: The Gorlos department lies beyond Xifeng Pass, one thousand eight hundred and ninety-seven li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Gorlos league lay beyond Xifeng Pass, eighteen hundred and ninety-seven li from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 東西距四百五十里，南北距六百六十里。

translations.literal: East to west it measures four hundred and fifty li; north to south six hundred and sixty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured four hundred and fifty li from east to west and six hundred and sixty li from north to south.

sentences.zh: 南盛京邊牆，東吉林府，西及北科爾沁。

translations.literal: South is the Mukden frontier wall; east is Jilin prefecture; west and north is Khorchin.
translations.idiomatic: The Mukden frontier wall lay to the south, Jilin to the east, and Khorchin to the west and north.

sentences.zh: 元太祖遣弟哈布圖哈薩爾征郭爾羅斯部，十六傳至烏巴什，即以為所部號。

translations.literal: The Yuan founding emperor sent his younger brother Khabutu Hasar to campaign against the Gorlos department; after sixteen generations it reached Ubash, who then took it as the name of his department.
translations.idiomatic: Genghis Khan sent his younger brother Khabutu Hasar against the Gorlos. Sixteen generations later came Ubash, who gave his name to the league.

sentences.zh: 子莽果仍之。

translations.literal: His son Manggu succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Manggu succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 天命九年，莽果子布木巴偕科爾沁台吉奧巴遣使乞好，優詔答之，遂率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tianming, Manggu's son Bumuba, together with Khorchin taiji Obai, sent envoys to sue for peace; a favorable edict answered them, and they led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tianming, Manggu's son Bumuba and Khorchin taiji Obai sent envoys to sue for peace. The court responded favorably, and they led their followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 會察哈爾林丹汗掠科爾沁，遣軍由郭爾羅斯境往援，至農安塔。

translations.literal: When Chakhar's Lin Dan Khan plundered Khorchin, troops were dispatched through Gorlos territory to aid them, reaching Nong'an Tower.
translations.idiomatic: When Chakhar's Lin Dan Khan raided Khorchin, Qing troops marched through Gorlos to relieve them as far as Nong'an Tower.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗遁，不敢復犯科爾沁及郭爾羅斯諸部。

translations.literal: Lin Dan Khan fled and dared not again invade Khorchin and the Gorlos departments.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Dan Khan fled and never again raided Khorchin or Gorlos.

sentences.zh: 嗣設扎薩克二：曰布木巴，爵鎮國公；

translations.literal: Thereafter two zasak were established: one called Bumuba, rank gushun gong;
translations.idiomatic: Two zasak were then established: Bumuba as gushun gong (defender duke);

sentences.zh: 曰固穆，為布木巴從弟，爵輔國公。

translations.literal: one called Gumu, Bumuba's younger cousin, rank fugo gong.
translations.idiomatic: and Gumu, Bumuba's younger cousin, as fugo gong (bulwark duke).

sentences.zh: 以與科爾沁同祖，附之，隸哲裏木盟。

translations.literal: Because they shared ancestry with Khorchin, they were attached to them and enrolled in the Jirem league.
translations.idiomatic: Sharing Khorchin ancestry, they were attached to Khorchin and enrolled in the Jirem league.

sentences.zh: 旗二：前旗駐固爾班察罕，後旗駐榛子嶺。

translations.literal: Two banners: the front banner stationed at Gurban Chahan, the rear banner at Zhenziling.
translations.idiomatic: It comprised two banners: the front banner at Gurban Chahan and the rear at Zhenziling.

sentences.zh: 爵三：扎薩克輔國公一，扎薩克台吉一，附鎮國公一。

translations.literal: Three titles: one zasak fugo gong, one zasak taiji, and one attached gushun gong.
translations.idiomatic: Three titles: one zasak fugo gong, one zasak taiji, and one attached gushun gong.

sentences.zh: 是部布木巴一旗為前旗，近吉林。

translations.literal: Within this department Bumuba's one banner was the front banner, near Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Bumuba's banner formed the front banner, near Jilin.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶五年，吉林將軍秀林奏以郭爾羅斯墾地置長春理事通判，並請分徵其租，上以非體斥之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Jiaqing, Jilin General Xiulin memorialized to place Gorlos cultivated land under a Changchun supervising subprefect, and requested dividing collection of its rent; the emperor dismissed it as improper.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Jiaqing Jilin General Xiulin proposed governing Gorlos cultivated land under a Changchun supervising subprefect and dividing rent collection. The emperor rejected the proposal as improper.

sentences.zh: 十傳至喀爾瑪什迪，於光緒九年削扎薩克，公爵如故。

translations.literal: After ten generations it reached Karmashidi; in the ninth year of Guangxu the zasak post was removed, but the duke's rank remained.
translations.idiomatic: Ten generations later came Karmashidi, who in the ninth year of Guangxu was stripped of the zasak post while retaining his ducal rank.

sentences.zh: 以其族等台吉巴雅斯呼朗代為扎薩克。

translations.literal: His kinsman of equal rank, taiji Bayaskhulang, replaced him as zasak.
translations.idiomatic: His kinsman taiji Bayaskhulang succeeded him as zasak.

sentences.zh: 光緒十三年，復升長春廳為府。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu, Changchun subprefecture was again promoted to a prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Guangxu Changchun was promoted from subprefecture to prefecture.

sentences.zh: 於是旗界內遼黃龍府舊地置農安縣，隸之。

translations.literal: Thereupon within the banner borders the old territory of Liao Huanglong prefecture was made Nong'an county, subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: Within the banner borders the old Huanglong prefecture lands became Nong'an county, subordinate to Changchun.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，又以墾地增廣，分置長嶺縣。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, because cultivated land had further expanded, Changling county was separately established.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year Changling county was carved out as cultivation expanded.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，分長春府地置德惠縣。

translations.literal: In the second year of Xuantong, Dehui county was established from Changchun prefecture territory.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Xuantong Dehui county was established from Changchun prefecture.

sentences.zh: 旋又定國家與蒙古分收民租例。

translations.literal: Soon regulations were also fixed for the state and Mongols to divide collection of settler rents.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations were soon fixed for dividing settler rents between the state and the Mongols.

sentences.zh: 是旗置郡縣凡四，皆隸吉林。

translations.literal: This banner had four prefectures and counties established, all subordinate to Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: The front banner gained four counties, all under Jilin.

sentences.zh: 固穆一旗為後旗，近黑龍江，亦當東三省鐵路之衝。

translations.literal: Gumu's one banner was the rear banner, near Heilongjiang, also athwart the Three Eastern Provinces railway.
translations.idiomatic: Gumu's banner formed the rear banner, near Heilongjiang and likewise on the main railway line.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，以墾地置肇州廳，隸黑龍江。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu, cultivated land was placed under Zhaozhou subprefecture, subordinate to Heilongjiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Guangxu cultivated land was placed under Zhaozhou subprefecture, subordinate to Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 後又分置肇東經歷。

translations.literal: Later a Zhaodong sub-bureau was also separately established.
translations.idiomatic: Later a Zhaodong sub-bureau was added.

sentences.zh: 是部二旗，墾地分隸吉林、黑龍江二省。

translations.literal: This department's two banners had cultivated land divided between Jilin and Heilongjiang provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Cultivated land in the two banners was divided between Jilin and Heilongjiang.

sentences.zh: 前旗有佐領二十三。

translations.literal: The front banner had twenty-three platoon leaders.
translations.idiomatic: The front banner had twenty-three platoon leaders.

sentences.zh: 後旗有佐領三十四。

translations.literal: The rear banner had thirty-four platoon leaders.
translations.idiomatic: The rear banner had thirty-four platoon leaders.
