sentences.zh: 喀喇沁部，在喜峰口外，至京師七百六十里。

translations.literal: The Harqin department lies beyond Xifeng Pass, seven hundred and sixty li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Harqin league lay beyond Xifeng Pass, seven hundred and sixty li from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 東西距五百里，南北距四百五十里。

translations.literal: East to west five hundred li; north to south four hundred and fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: It measured five hundred li east to west and four hundred and fifty li north to south.

sentences.zh: 東土默特及敖漢，西察哈爾正藍旗牧廠，南盛京邊牆，北翁牛特。

translations.literal: East are Tumed and Aohan; west is Chakhar's Plain Blue Banner pasture grounds; south is the Mukden frontier wall; north is Ongniud.
translations.idiomatic: Tumed and Aohan lay to the east, Chakhar Plain Blue Banner pastures to the west, the Mukden wall to the south, and Ongniud to the north.

sentences.zh: 元時有劄爾楚泰者，生濟拉瑪，佐元太祖有功。

translations.literal: In Yuan times there was Jarchutai, who bore Jirema, who aided the Yuan founding emperor with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuan times Jarchutai fathered Jirema, who served the founding emperor with distinction.

sentences.zh: 七傳至和通，有眾六千戶，遊牧額沁河，號所部曰喀喇沁。

translations.literal: Seven generations later it reached Hetong, with a following of six thousand households, pasturing on the Ejin River, styling the department Harqin.
translations.idiomatic: Seven generations later came Hetong, with six thousand households pasturing on the Ejin River and taking the name Harqin for the league.

sentences.zh: 子格哷博羅特繼之。

translations.literal: His son Geleg Borot succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Geleg Borot succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 生子二：長格哷勒泰宰桑，為扎薩克杜棱貝勒固嚕思奇布及扎薩克一等塔布囊格哷爾二旗祖；

translations.literal: He bore two sons: the eldest, Gelegletu jaisang, was ancestor of zasak Duoluo beile Gülüsichib and zasak first-rank tabunang Gele'er of the two banners;
translations.idiomatic: He had two sons: the elder Gelegletu jaisang founded the banners of zasak Duoluo beile Gülüsichib and first-rank tabunang Gele'er;

sentences.zh: 次圖嚕巴圖爾，為扎薩克鎮國公色棱一旗祖。

translations.literal: the younger, Tulubaatur, was ancestor of zasak gushun gong Seleng's one banner.
translations.idiomatic: the younger Tulubaatur founded the banner of zasak gushun gong Seleng.

sentences.zh: 格哷勒泰宰桑子四：長恩克，次准圖，次鄂穆克圖，均居喀喇沁。

translations.literal: Gelegletu jaisang had four sons: the eldest Enke, second Zhuntu, third Omoktu—all dwelt in Harqin.
translations.idiomatic: Gelegletu jaisang had four sons—Enke, Zhuntu, and Omoktu—who all remained in Harqin.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年二月，恩克曾孫蘇布地以察哈爾林丹汗虐其部，偕弟萬丹偉徵等乞內附，表奏：「察哈爾汗不道，喀喇沁被虐，因偕土默特、鄂爾多斯、阿巴噶、喀爾喀諸部兵，赴土默特之趙城，擊察哈爾兵四萬。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Tiancong, Enke's great-grandson Subude, because Chakhar's Lin Dan Khan mistreated his department, together with his younger brothers Wandan, Weijeng, and others begged to submit within the frontier, memorializing: "The Chakhar Khan is without the Way; Harqin is oppressed. Therefore together with Tumed, Ordos, Abaga, and Khalkha troops we went to Tumed's Zhaocheng and struck Chakhar forces of forty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tiancong year two Subude, great-grandson of Enke, because Lin Dan Khan of Chakhar oppressed his people, asked to submit with his brothers Wandan and Weijeng, memorializing: "The Chakhar khan is unjust and Harqin suffers. We therefore joined Tumed, Ordos, Abaga, and Khalkha troops at Tumed's Zhaocheng and routed forty thousand Chakhar soldiers.

sentences.zh: 還，值赴明請賞兵三千，復殪之。

translations.literal: Returning, we encountered three thousand troops bound for Ming to seek rewards and annihilated them again.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march we met three thousand Ming-bound troops seeking rewards and destroyed them as well.

sentences.zh: 察哈爾根本動搖，事機可乘。

translations.literal: Chakhar's foundations are shaken; the opportunity may be seized.
translations.idiomatic: Chakhar's foundations are shaken and the moment can be seized.

sentences.zh: 皇帝儻興師進剿，喀喇沁當先諸部至。」

translations.literal: If the emperor should raise troops for a punitive advance, Harqin will reach ahead of all other departments."
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty sends a punitive expedition, Harqin will march ahead of all the other leagues.

sentences.zh: 諭遣使面議。

translations.literal: An edict ordered envoys sent to discuss in person.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered envoys to discuss the matter in person.

sentences.zh: 七月，遣喇嘛偕五百三十八人來朝，命貝勒阿濟格、碩讬迎宴，刑白馬烏牛誓。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, lamas together with five hundred thirty-eight persons came to court; beile Ajige and Shuotuo were ordered to welcome and feast them, swearing an oath by slaughtering a white horse and black ox.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month lamas and five hundred thirty-eight followers came to court. Beile Ajige and Shuotuo were sent to welcome them and they swore an oath over a white horse and black ox.

sentences.zh: 九月，上親征察哈爾，蘇布地等迎會於綽洛郭勒，賜賚甚厚。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the emperor personally campaigned against Chakhar; Subude and others met him at Chuoluo Gol and received very generous gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the emperor campaigned personally against Chakhar. Subude met him at Chuoluo Gol and received lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，敕所部遵國憲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year, an edict ordered the department to observe the national constitution.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year three the court ordered them to observe Qing law.

sentences.zh: 六月，蘇布地及圖嚕巴圖爾孫色棱等率屬來歸，詔還舊牧。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Subude and Tulubaatur's grandson Seleng and others led their followers to submit; an edict restored their old pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Subude, Seleng grandson of Tulubaatur, and others led their followers to submit, and the court restored their old pastures.

sentences.zh: 十月，上征明，以塔布囊布林哈圖為導，入遵化，駐兵羅文峪。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the emperor campaigned against Ming, with tabunang Burin Hatu as guide, entering Zunhua and encamping troops at Luowen Valley.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the emperor marched against the Ming with tabunang Burin Hatu as guide, entered Zunhua, and encamped at Luowen Valley.

sentences.zh: 四年，布林哈圖為明兵所圍，擊敗之，擒副將丁啟明及遊擊一、都司二。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Burin Hatu was surrounded by Ming troops; he defeated them and captured Vice General Ding Qiming, one mobile corps commander, and two brigade commanders.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Burin Hatu, surrounded by Ming troops, defeated them and captured Vice General Ding Qiming, one brigade commander, and two colonels.

sentences.zh: 詔嘉其功，賜莊田僕從及金幣。

translations.literal: An edict praised his merit and granted estate lands, servants, and gold coins.
translations.idiomatic: The court praised his merit and granted estate lands, retainers, and gold.

sentences.zh: 六月，由都爾弼從征察哈爾，林丹汗遁，以所收察哈爾糧貯遼河守之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, joining the campaign against Chakhar via Duerbi, Lin Dan Khan fled; the Chakhar grain captured was stored along the Liao River for guarding.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he joined the Chakhar campaign through Duerbi. Lin Dan Khan fled, and captured Chakhar grain was stored along the Liao for garrison use.

sentences.zh: 復分兵隨貝勒阿濟格略明大同、宣府邊。

translations.literal: Troops were again divided to follow beile Ajige in raiding the Ming borders of Datong and Xuanfu.
translations.idiomatic: Detachments also followed beile Ajige in raiding the Datong and Xuanfu borders.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，偕巴林、阿嚕科爾沁、阿巴噶諸部兵收撫察哈爾流民。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, together with Baarin, Alxa Khorchin, and Abaga troops, Chakhar displaced persons were gathered and settled.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year eight he joined Baarin, Alxa Khorchin, and Abaga forces in resettling Chakhar refugees.

sentences.zh: 五月，從征明大同，至朔州。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, joining the campaign against Ming at Datong, they reached Shuozhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he joined the Datong campaign and reached Shuozhou.

sentences.zh: 九年正月，詔編所部佐領，以蘇布地子固嚕思奇布掌右翼，色棱掌左翼。

translations.literal: In the first month of the ninth year, an edict organized the department's platoon leaders; Subude's son Gülüsichib governed the right wing, Seleng the left wing.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year nine platoon leaders were organized under Subude's son Gülüsichib on the right wing and Seleng on the left.

sentences.zh: 五月，選兵從征明，敗之於遼河源。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, selected troops joined the campaign against Ming and defeated them at the Liao River source.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month selected troops joined the Ming campaign and defeated the enemy at the Liao headwaters.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，詔授布林哈圖一等子，賜號岱達爾漢塔布囊。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongde, an edict granted Burin Hatu first-rank zi and the title Daider Han tabunang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde Burin Hatu was granted first-rank zi and the title Daider Han tabunang.

sentences.zh: 二年，遣大臣阿什達爾漢等赴其部理庶獄。

translations.literal: In the second year, ministers Ashi Daerhan and others were sent to their department to handle ordinary cases.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year Ashi Daerhan and other ministers were sent to try ordinary cases in Harqin.

sentences.zh: 三年九月，隨大軍自密雲入明邊，敗其兵六千。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the third year, following the main army from Miyun into the Ming border, they defeated six thousand of their troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year three the main army entered the Ming border through Miyun and defeated six thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 十月，從征前屯衛及寧遠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, joining campaigns at Qiantun garrison and Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he joined campaigns at Qiantun and Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 七年，從圍薊州，過北京，下山東。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, joining the siege of Jizhou, passing Beijing, descending into Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he joined the siege of Jizhou, passed Beijing, and marched into Shandong.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, following entry through Shanhai Pass, they struck the rebel Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi he followed the army through Shanhai Pass against Li Zicheng's rebels.

sentences.zh: 六年，從征喀爾喀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, joining the campaign against Khalkha.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the Khalkha campaign.

sentences.zh: 康熙十三年，大軍剿逆籓耿精忠等，所部塔布囊霍濟格爾偕土默特塔布囊善達等，以兵赴兗州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, as the main army suppressed the rebel princes Geng Jingzhong and others, the department's tabunang Hojiger, together with Tumed tabunang Shanda and others, brought troops to Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Kangxi, during campaigns against the rebel princes Geng Jingzhong, tabunang Hojiger and Tumed tabunang Shanda led troops to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年，上諭曰：「塔布囊霍濟格爾等前自兗州赴浙江，聽康親王傑書調度。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, the emperor instructed: "Tabunang Hojiger and others previously went from Yanzhou to Zhejiang and followed Prince Kang Jieshu's command.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year the emperor said: "Tabunang Hojiger and others went from Yanzhou to Zhejiang under Prince Kang Jieshu's command.

sentences.zh: 各統所屬官兵征剿逆賊，深入閩省，同大兵平定逆籓耿精忠。

translations.literal: Each commanded his own officers and troops to campaign against the rebels, penetrating deep into Fujian, and together with the main army pacified the rebel prince Geng Jingzhong.
translations.idiomatic: They led their troops deep into Fujian and, with the main armies, pacified the rebel prince Geng Jingzhong.

sentences.zh: 行間效力，身先士卒，衝鋒陷陣，奮勇用命，深為可嘉。

translations.literal: In the field they rendered service, personally leading troops before all others, charging formations and breaking enemy lines, fighting bravely at peril of life—deeply praiseworthy.
translations.idiomatic: In battle they led from the front, charged enemy lines, and fought with conspicuous valor.

sentences.zh: 宜降恩綸，即行議敘，以勵後效。」

translations.literal: Favor should be descended; rewards should be deliberated immediately to encourage later service."
translations.idiomatic: Rewards should be granted at once to encourage others.

sentences.zh: 二十年，上駐蹕和爾和，諭曰：「塔布囊霍濟格爾出征時最著勤勞，今已溘逝。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the emperor halted at Herhe and instructed: "Tabunang Hojiger was most noted for labor on campaign; he has now suddenly died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, encamped at Herhe, the emperor said: "Tabunang Hojiger served with exceptional diligence on campaign and has now died.

sentences.zh: 朕至此地，遣散秩大臣鄂齊等攜茶酒往奠。」

translations.literal: I have come to this place and dispatch the ungraded grand minister Oqi and others bearing tea and wine to make offerings."
translations.idiomatic: I have come here and send Grand Minister Oqi with tea and wine to perform the rites.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，敘平浙江、福建功，賜參領巴雅爾等十人世職。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, for pacifying Zhejiang and Fujian, Captain Bayar and ten others received hereditary office.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year ten officers including Captain Bayar received hereditary honors for pacifying Zhejiang and Fujian.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，從征噶爾丹，敗之於烏蘭布通。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, joining the campaign against Galdan, he was defeated at Ulan Butung.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he joined the campaign against Galdan and helped defeat him at Ulan Butung.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，詔增設一旗，以塔布囊格哷爾領之。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, an edict added one more banner, with tabunang Gele'er to lead it.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year the court added a third banner under tabunang Gele'er.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，徵所部兵千赴推河防禦策妄阿喇布坦，尋命侍郎覺和托等攜帑萬兩賜之，雍正九年，從征噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, one thousand troops of the department were levied to the Tui River to defend against Tsewang Arabtan; soon Vice Minister Jiaohetuo and others were ordered to bring ten thousand taels of treasury funds as gifts. In the ninth year of Yongzheng, joining the campaign against Galdan Tsering.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fourth year a thousand Harqin troops were sent to the Tui River against Tsewang Arabtan, and Vice Minister Jiaohetuo was sent with ten thousand taels as reward. In the ninth year of Yongzheng they joined the campaign against Galdan Tsering.

sentences.zh: 所部初設二旗，右翼駐錫伯河北，左翼駐巴顏珠爾克；

translations.literal: The department at first had two banners established: the right wing stationed north of the Xibo River, the left wing at Bayan Zhurhe;
translations.idiomatic: The league began with two banners: the right wing north of the Xibo River and the left at Bayan Zhurhe;

sentences.zh: 後增一旗，駐左右翼界內。

translations.literal: later one banner was added, stationed within the border between left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: later a third banner was added between the two wings.

sentences.zh: 爵六：親王品級扎薩克多羅杜棱郡王一，由貝勒晉襲；

translations.literal: Six titles: one zasak Duoluo Duling junwang of qinwang rank, advanced by inheritance from beile;
translations.idiomatic: Six titles: one zasak Duoluo Duling junwang of princely rank, inherited by promotion from beile;

sentences.zh: 附鎮國公一，由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: one attached gushun gong, demoted by inheritance from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one attached gushun gong (defender duke), demoted from beizi rank;

sentences.zh: 輔國公一；

translations.literal: one fugo gong;
translations.idiomatic: one fugo gong (bulwark duke);

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅貝勒一，由貝子晉襲；

translations.literal: one zasak duoluo beile, advanced by inheritance from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak duoluo beile, inherited by promotion from beizi;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克固山貝子一，由鎮國公晉襲；

translations.literal: one zasak gushan beizi, advanced by inheritance from gushun gong;
translations.idiomatic: one zasak gushan beizi, inherited by promotion from gushun gong;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克公品級一等塔布囊一。

translations.literal: one zasak gong-rank first-class tabunang.
translations.idiomatic: and one zasak first-class tabunang of gong rank.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，以所部墾地設平泉州。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, cultivated land within the department was made Pingquan prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year of Qianlong cultivated land within the league became Pingquan prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶八年，降爵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiaqing, titles were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiaqing several titles were reduced.

sentences.zh: 貝子丹巴多爾濟以獲逆犯陳德功，予貝勒，官至領侍衛內大臣、御前大臣，卒。

translations.literal: Beizi Danba Dorji, for capturing the rebel Chen Degong, was granted beile; he reached the posts of chief guard of the inner service and grand minister in attendance before the throne, then died.
translations.idiomatic: Beizi Danba Dorji was promoted to beile for capturing the rebel Chen Degong, served as chief guard of the inner service and grand minister before the throne, and died in office.

sentences.zh: 光緒二十三年，扎薩克一等台吉塔布囊巴特瑪鄂特薩爾以事革，復以貝勒熙淩阿襲。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu, zasak first-rank taiji tabunang Batma Otsar was dismissed for cause; beile Xiling'a again inherited.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year of Guangxu zasak first-rank taiji tabunang Batma Otsar was dismissed, and beile Xiling'a inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 存爵五。

translations.literal: Five titles remain.
translations.idiomatic: Five titles remained in office.

sentences.zh: 是部招民墾地最在先。

translations.literal: This department recruited settlers to open land earliest of all.
translations.idiomatic: Harqin was the first league to recruit Han settlers for cultivation.

sentences.zh: 乾隆十四年，始定不許容留民人多墾地畝之禁。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong, a prohibition was first fixed against retaining settlers who opened excessive acreage.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Qianlong the court first barred banners from retaining settlers who opened excessive acreage.

sentences.zh: 道光十九年，復定喀喇沁、土默特種地民人不得以所種地畝折算蒙古賒貸銀錢例。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year of Daoguang, it was again fixed that Harqin and Tumed cultivating settlers might not use planted acreage to calculate Mongol credit silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year of Daoguang the court again barred Harqin and Tumed settlers from using planted acreage to settle Mongol loans in silver.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，敖漢部金丹道匪之變，是部同時被擾。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, during the Jindandao bandit uprising in the Aohan department, this department was disturbed at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, during the Jindandao uprising in Aohan, Harqin was disturbed as well.

sentences.zh: 事平，特頒帑賑恤之。

translations.literal: When the affair was settled, treasury funds were specially issued for relief.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored, the court issued special relief funds.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，熱河都統錫良以左翼旗招華商承辦全旗五金各礦，中旗同道勝銀行立有合同，開八里罕等地金礦，與定章應聲明華、洋股本若干，及只准指定一處不准兼指數處者不符，請飭外務部妥議辦法。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Rehe Governor-General Xiliang, because the left-wing banner recruited Chinese merchants to undertake all the banner's metal and mineral enterprises, and the central banner had a contract with the Daosheng Bank to open gold mines at Balihan and elsewhere—inconsistent with regulations requiring declared Chinese and foreign capital amounts and permitting only one designated site, not several—requested the Foreign Ministry to deliberate proper measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year Rehe Governor-General Xiliang reported that the left-wing banner had contracted Chinese merchants for all banner mines and the central banner with Daosheng Bank to open gold mines at Balihan—contrary to regulations on declared capital and single-site concessions—and asked the Foreign Ministry to settle the matter.

sentences.zh: 下所司議申定章約束之。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the responsible offices to deliberate and apply the fixed regulations as restraint.
translations.idiomatic: The case was referred to the responsible offices to enforce the regulations.

sentences.zh: 是部右翼旗有佐領四十四，中旗有佐領三十八，左翼旗有佐領四十，與土默特二旗統盟於卓索圖。

translations.literal: This department's right-wing banner had forty-four platoon leaders, the central banner thirty-eight, the left-wing banner forty; together with Tumed's two banners they formed the Josotu league.
translations.idiomatic: The right wing had forty-four platoon leaders, the center thirty-eight, and the left wing forty; together with Tumed's two banners they formed the Josotu league.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶中，設熱河都統後，是盟與昭烏達盟重大事件，皆由都統專奏。

translations.literal: In the Jiaqing period, after the Rehe governor-general was established, major affairs of this league and the Zhaowuda league were all memorialized solely by the governor-general.
translations.idiomatic: After the Rehe governor-general was established in the Jiaqing period, major affairs of this league and Zhaowuda were reported directly by the governor-general.

sentences.zh: 道光末，籌直隸海防，咸豐初，剿粵匪，皆徵是盟之兵，與哲裏木、昭烏達號東三盟兵，頗著功績雲。

translations.literal: At the end of Daoguang, planning Zhili coastal defense; at the beginning of Xianfeng, suppressing the Cantonese rebels—all summoned troops of this league, together with the Jirem and Zhaowuda forces styled the eastern three leagues' troops, with considerable recorded merit.
translations.idiomatic: From late Daoguang coastal defense through early Xianfeng campaigns against the Taiping rebels, the court repeatedly called up this league's troops together with Jirem and Zhaowuda as the eastern three leagues, and they won considerable distinction.

sentences.zh: 土默特部，在喜峰口外，至京師千里。

translations.literal: The Tumed department lies beyond Xifeng Pass, one thousand li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Tumed league lay beyond Xifeng Pass, a thousand li from Beijing.

sentences.zh: 東西距四百六十里，南北距三百有十里。

translations.literal: East-west distance four hundred and sixty li; north-south distance three hundred and ten li.
translations.idiomatic: Its territory measured four hundred and sixty li east to west and three hundred and ten li north to south.

sentences.zh: 東養息牧牧廠，西喀喇沁，南盛京邊牆，北喀爾喀左翼及敖漢。

translations.literal: East is Yangximu pasture grounds; west is Harqin; south is the Mukden frontier wall; north are Khalkha Left Wing and Aohan.
translations.idiomatic: Yangximu pastures lay to the east, Harqin to the west, the Mukden wall to the south, and Khalkha Left Wing and Aohan to the north.

sentences.zh: 土默特分左右翼，異姓同牧。

translations.literal: Tumed was divided into left and right wings; different surnames pastured together.
translations.idiomatic: Tumed was split into left and right wings in which families of different lineage pastured together.

sentences.zh: 主左翼者為元臣濟拉瑪裔。

translations.literal: The one governing the left wing was a descendant of the Yuan minister Jirema.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing was headed by descendants of the Yuan minister Jirema.

sentences.zh: 自濟拉瑪十三傳至善巴，與喀喇沁為近族。

translations.literal: Thirteen generations from Jirema to Shanba; they were near kin to Harqin.
translations.idiomatic: Thirteen generations descended from Jirema to Shanba, who were close kin to Harqin.

sentences.zh: 主右翼者為元太祖裔。

translations.literal: The one governing the right wing was a descendant of the Yuan founding emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The right wing was headed by descendants of the Yuan founding emperor.

sentences.zh: 自元太祖十九傳至鄂木布楚琥爾，生子固穆，與歸化城土默特為近族。

translations.literal: Nineteen generations from the Yuan founding emperor to Ombochuhor; he bore Gumu, near kin to the Guihuacheng Tumed.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteen generations descended from the founding emperor to Ombochuhor, who fathered Gumu and were close kin to the Guihuacheng Tumed.

sentences.zh: 天總三年，善巴、鄂木布楚琥爾各率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the third year of Tiancong, Shanba and Ombochuhor each led their followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Tiancong, Shanba and Ombochuhor each led their followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，選兵從征明，頒示軍律。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year, troops were selected to follow the campaign against Ming, and military regulations were promulgated.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year eight they mobilized troops for the Ming campaign and promulgated military regulations.

sentences.zh: 七月，由獨石口入明邊，會大軍於保安州，分兵隸都統武訥格，略察哈爾邊。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, entering the Ming frontier through Dushikou, they joined the main army at Bao'an Prefecture; detachments were assigned to Commander-in-Chief Unge and raided the Chakhar border.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month they entered Ming territory through Dushikou, joined the main force at Bao'an, and detachments under Commander-in-Chief Unge raided the Chakhar frontier.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔編所部佐領，設扎薩克三：曰善巴，曰賡格爾，曰鄂木布楚琥爾。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an edict organized the department's platoon leaders and established three zasak: Shanba, Genger, and Ombochuhor.
translations.idiomatic: In year nine the court organized their platoon leaders and appointed three zasak—Shanba, Genger, and Ombochuhor.

sentences.zh: 賡格爾者，善巴族也。

translations.literal: Genger was of Shanba's clan.
translations.idiomatic: Genger belonged to Shanba's clan.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，以罪削扎薩克，善巴領其眾。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, for crime his zasak rank was stripped; Shanba took over his following.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongde Genger was stripped of his zasak rank for misconduct and Shanba assumed command of his people.

sentences.zh: 自是土默特分左右翼，命善巴及鄂木布楚琥爾掌之。

translations.literal: From this time Tumed was divided into left and right wings, with orders that Shanba and Ombochuhor govern them.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Tumed was formally split into left and right wings under Shanba and Ombochuhor.

sentences.zh: 是年遣大臣阿什達爾漢等赴其部理庶獄。

translations.literal: That year ministers Asha Darhan and others were dispatched to the department to handle ordinary lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Asha Darhan and other ministers were sent to adjudicate civil cases in the league.

sentences.zh: 六年，從圍明錦州，敗總督洪承疇援兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, joining the siege of Ming Jinzhou, they defeated Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou's relief army.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year they joined the siege of Jinzhou and routed Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou's relief force.

sentences.zh: 八年，隨饒餘貝勒阿巴泰征明。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, they followed Raoyu Beile Abatai in campaigning against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year they followed Raoyu Beile Abatai on a Ming campaign.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入山海關，擊流賊李自成。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, following the entry through Shanhai Pass, they struck the rebel Li Zicheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Shunzhi they marched through Shanhai Pass and fought Li Zicheng's rebels.

sentences.zh: 三年，隨剿蘇尼特部叛人騰機思。

translations.literal: In the third year, they followed in suppressing the Sunid rebel Tenggis.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they joined the suppression of the Sunid rebel Tenggis.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，喀爾喀台吉巴爾布冰圖來歸，詔附土默特牧。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi, Khalkha taiji Barbu Bingtu came to submit; an edict attached him to Tumed pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Kangxi Khalkha taiji Barbu Bingtu submitted, and the court ordered him to pasture under Tumed.

sentences.zh: 十三年，大軍剿逆籓耿精忠等，詔所部塔布囊善達偕喀喇沁塔布囊霍濟格爾以兵赴兗州聽調。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, when the main army suppressed the rebel feudatories Geng Jingzhong and others, an edict ordered tabunang Shanda of the department together with Harqin tabunang Huojiger to bring troops to Yanzhou for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, during the campaign against Geng Jingzhong and other rebel princes, the court ordered Tumed tabunang Shanda and Harqin tabunang Huojiger to Yanzhou with their troops.

sentences.zh: 十七年，調赴浙江，隨康親王傑書進剿。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, transferred to Zhejiang, they followed Prince Kang Jieshu in the punitive advance.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year they were sent to Zhejiang and followed Prince Kang Jieshu on the punitive campaign.

sentences.zh: 閩地悉定，諭優敘。

translations.literal: When Fujian was wholly pacified, an edict granted preferential recognition of merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Fujian was fully pacified, the court granted them preferential honors for merit.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，詔選兵千隨公傅爾丹屯鄂爾坤。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, an edict selected one thousand troops to follow Duke Furdan in garrisoning the Ergun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year the court detailed a thousand men to garrison the Ergun with Duke Furdan.

sentences.zh: 五十九年，以旱歉收，賜帑賑之。

translations.literal: In the fifty-ninth year, because drought brought poor harvests, treasury funds were granted for relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-ninth year drought and failed harvests brought imperial relief funds.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，塔布囊沙津達賚隨大軍防禦準噶爾。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongzheng, tabunang Shajin Dabai followed the main army in defense against the Dzungars.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongzheng tabunang Shajin Dabai joined the main army against the Dzungars.

sentences.zh: 七年，封鎮國公。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, he was enfeoffed as gushun gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was enfeoffed as Gushun Gong.

sentences.zh: 九年，大將軍傅爾丹擊準噶爾于和通呼爾哈諾爾，沙津達賚陣逃，削爵；

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Grand Marshal Furdan attacked the Dzungars at Khorgol; Shajin Dabai fled in battle and was stripped of rank;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Grand Marshal Furdan attacked the Dzungars at Khorgol. Shajin Dabai fled in battle and lost his title;

sentences.zh: 而土默特部將之隨參贊內大臣馬蘭泰者，敗賊西爾哈昭，斬獲甚眾，稍雪恥焉。

translations.literal: Yet Tumed generals who followed Grand Coordinator and Inner Minister Malantai defeated the enemy at Xierhazhao with many killed and captured, somewhat avenging the shame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Tumed officers under Grand Coordinator Malantai defeated the enemy at Xierhazhao with heavy kills and captures, partly redeeming the disgrace.

sentences.zh: 所部二旗，左翼駐海他哈山，右翼駐巴顏和朔，隸卓索圖盟。

translations.literal: The department had two banners: the left wing garrisoned at Haitaha Mountain, the right at Bayan Hosho, subordinate to the Josotu League.
translations.idiomatic: Its two banners garrisoned the left wing at Haitaha Mountain and the right at Bayan Hosho under the Josotu League.

sentences.zh: 爵三：扎薩克多羅達爾漢貝勒一，由鎮國公晉襲；

translations.literal: Three ranks: one zasak duoluo darhan beile, advanced from gushun gong succession;
translations.idiomatic: Three noble ranks were held: one zasak duoluo darhan beile, promoted from Gushun Gong;

sentences.zh: 附喀爾喀貝勒一；

translations.literal: one attached Khalkha beile;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Khalkha beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克固山貝子一。

translations.literal: one zasak gushan beizi.
translations.idiomatic: and one zasak gushan beizi.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十一年，以所部墾地置朝陽縣。

translations.literal: In the forty-first year of Qianlong, Chaoyang County was established on reclaimed land within the department.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-first year of Qianlong reclaimed lands within the league were organized as Chaoyang County.

sentences.zh: 同治九年，以右翼旗箭丁等屢控扎薩克貝子索特那木色登科派太重，於是管旗章京阿阿尚等以因公派錢不能體恤，均革。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Tongzhi, because right-wing archer households repeatedly complained that zasak beile Sotenam Sedengke's levies were too heavy, banner secretary Aashang and others, for being unable to temper official levy collections, were all dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Tongzhi right-wing archer households repeatedly protested that zasak beile Sotenam Sedengke's levies were excessive; banner secretary Aashang and others were dismissed for failing to moderate official collections.

sentences.zh: 熱河都統庫克吉泰因奏變通土默特比丁章程，申明交納丁錢舊章，箭丁子女不許妄行役使及隨侍陪嫁，八枝箭丁仍歸土默特管束。

translations.literal: Rehe Governor-General Kukejitai memorialized to adjust Tumed arrow-household regulations, clarifying old rules on payment of quota silver, forbidding the wrongful impressment of archer households' sons for service and dowry attendants, and restoring eight branches of archer households to Tumed jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: Rehe governor-general Kukejitai memorialized to revise Tumed military-household rules, reaffirmed the old silver quota, barred wrongful impressment of archers' sons and dowry servants, and returned eight branches of archer households to Tumed authority.

sentences.zh: 光緒十七年，敖漢部金丹道匪之變，是部同時被擾。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, when the Aohan Jindan Dao bandit disturbance broke out, this department was raided at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Guangxu, when the Aohan Jindan Dao uprising erupted, Tumed was attacked as well.

sentences.zh: 事平，賑恤之。

translations.literal: When affairs were settled, relief was granted.
translations.idiomatic: After order was restored, the court granted relief.

sentences.zh: 左翼有佐領八十，右翼有佐領九十，於諸旗為特多焉。

translations.literal: The left wing had eighty platoon leaders and the right ninety—exceptionally many among the banners.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing held eighty platoon leaders and the right ninety, an unusually high count among the banners.
